--!strict

local CornLayout = {
	Height = 8,
	Spacing = 3,
	Seed = 817,
	ChunkCells = 12,
	RenderRadius = 150,
	ElevatedRadius = 200,
	DenseRadius = 60,
	MediumRadius = 130,
}

export type Plant = Model | BasePart
export type Box = { Frame: CFrame, HalfSize: Vector2 }
export type Circle = { Center: Vector3, Radius: number }
export type Exclusions = { Boxes: { Box }, Circles: { Circle }, Signature: string }

local SLOT_RADIUS = 6
local BOX_PADDING = 1.5

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function CornLayout.Bounds(plant: Plant): (CFrame, Vector3)
	if plant:IsA("Model") then
		return plant:GetBoundingBox()
	end
	return plant.CFrame, plant.Size
end

function CornLayout.PrepareTemplate(source: Instance, height: number?): (Plant?, string?)
	if not source:IsA("Model") and not source:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, "Corn source must be a Model or BasePart"
	end
	local targetHeight = height or CornLayout.Height
	if not finite(targetHeight) or targetHeight <= 0 then
		return nil, "Corn height must be positive and finite"
	end
	local items = source:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(items, source)
	local partCount = 0
	for _, item in items do
		if item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			return nil, "Corn source contains code"
		end
		if
			item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return nil, "Corn source must contain only static art"
		end
		if not item.Archivable then
			return nil, "Corn source has non-Archivable contents"
		end
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			partCount += 1
		end
	end
	if partCount == 0 then
		return nil, "Corn source has no BaseParts"
	end

	local prepared = source:Clone() :: Plant?
	if not prepared then
		return nil, "Corn source could not be cloned"
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local _, size = CornLayout.Bounds(prepared :: Plant)
		if not finite(size.Y) or size.Y <= 0 then
			error("Corn source has no usable height")
		end
		local ratio = targetHeight / size.Y
		if prepared:IsA("Model") then
			prepared:ScaleTo(prepared:GetScale() * ratio)
		else
			prepared.Size *= ratio
			for _, item in prepared:GetChildren() do
				if item:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					item.Scale *= ratio
				end
			end
		end
		-- The imported plant has one mesh plus import poses/animation metadata.
		-- Keep only that normalized mesh on decorative copies; the source is untouched.
		if prepared:IsA("Model") and partCount == 1 then
			local mesh = prepared:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
			if mesh and mesh:IsA("MeshPart") then
				mesh.Parent = nil
				prepared:Destroy()
				prepared = mesh
			end
		end
		for _, item in prepared:GetDescendants() do
			if
				item:IsA("AnimationController")
				or (item:IsA("Folder") and item.Name == "InitialPoses")
			then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local clones = prepared:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(clones, prepared)
		for _, item in clones do
			-- Art tags must not become gameplay bindings on every decorative clone.
			for _, tag in item:GetTags() do
				item:RemoveTag(tag)
			end
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.DoubleSided = true
				end
			end
		end
		prepared:PivotTo(CornLayout.PivotForPlant(prepared, Vector3.zero, 0))
	end)
	if not ok then
		prepared:Destroy()
		return nil, tostring(problem)
	end
	return prepared, nil
end

function CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant: Plant, groundPosition: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(plant)
	local boundsFromPivot = plant:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds)
	return CFrame.new(groundPosition + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
		* boundsFromPivot:Inverse()
end

function CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field: BasePart): (number, number, number, number)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.ceil(-half.X / CornLayout.Spacing),
		math.floor(half.X / CornLayout.Spacing),
		math.ceil(-half.Z / CornLayout.Spacing),
		math.floor(half.Z / CornLayout.Spacing)
end

function CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local hashX = (column * 92837111 + row * 689287499 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local hashZ = (column * 19349663 + row * 83492791 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local stagger = if row % 2 == 0 then -CornLayout.Spacing * 0.15 else CornLayout.Spacing * 0.15
	local x = column * CornLayout.Spacing
		+ stagger
		+ (hashX / 104729 - 0.5) * CornLayout.Spacing * 0.12
	local z = row * CornLayout.Spacing + (hashZ / 104729 - 0.5) * CornLayout.Spacing * 0.12
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(math.clamp(x, -half.X, half.X), -half.Y, math.clamp(z, -half.Z, half.Z))
	)
end

local function hash(column: number, row: number, salt: number): number
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + CornLayout.Seed * salt) % 104729) / 104729
end

function CornLayout.CellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local point = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(
				point.X + (hash(column, row, 17) * 2 - 1) * CornLayout.Spacing * 0.1,
				-half.X,
				half.X
			),
			point.Y,
			math.clamp(
				point.Z + (hash(column, row, 31) * 2 - 1) * CornLayout.Spacing * 0.1,
				-half.Z,
				half.Z
			)
		)
	)
end

function CornLayout.CellYaw(column: number, row: number): number
	local sign = if hash(column, row, 47) < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	return math.rad(10 + hash(column, row, 61) * 20) * sign
end

function CornLayout.HeightFactor(column: number, row: number): number
	local sign = if hash(column, row, 79) < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	return 1 + sign * (0.1 + hash(column, row, 97) * 0.05)
end

function CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant: Plant, column: number, row: number)
	local factor = CornLayout.HeightFactor(column, row)
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)
	else
		plant:ScaleTo(plant:GetScale() * factor)
	end
end

local function footprint(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, padding: number): Box
	local look = frame.LookVector
	local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	local flat = CFrame.new(frame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	local half = size / 2
	local right = flat.RightVector
	local forward = flat.LookVector
	local width = math.abs(right:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	local depth = math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	return { Frame = flat, HalfSize = Vector2.new(width + padding, depth + padding) }
end

local function authorDescendants(map: Model): { Instance }
	local result: { Instance } = {}
	local stack = map:GetChildren()
	while #stack > 0 do
		local item = table.remove(stack)
		local owned = item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		local decoration = owned
			and (
				(item.Name == "EditorPreview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "EditorFieldOverview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "CornClientPlants" and item:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") == true)
				or item.Name == "CornRoundRuntime"
			)
		if decoration then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(result, item)
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(stack, child)
		end
	end
	return result
end
function CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map: Model, field: BasePart): Exclusions
	local boxes: { Box } = {}
	local circles: { Circle } = {}
	local signatures: { string } = { tostring(field.CFrame) .. "/" .. tostring(field.Size) }
	local included: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	local function addBox(part: BasePart, padding: number)
		if included[part] then
			return
		end
		included[part] = true
		table.insert(boxes, footprint(part.CFrame, part.Size, padding))
		table.insert(
			signatures,
			part:GetFullName()
				.. "/box/"
				.. tostring(part.CFrame)
				.. "/"
				.. tostring(part.Size)
				.. "/"
				.. padding
		)
	end
	for _, folderName in { "NoCornZones", "Props" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if folder then
			for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
				if item:IsA("BasePart") then
					addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, item in authorDescendants(map) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			if item:HasTag("corn_no_corn_zone") then
				addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
			end
			if item:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = SLOT_RADIUS })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/slot/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			elseif item:HasTag("corn_spawn") then
				addBox(item, 4)
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = 10 })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/spawn/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if gate then
		local door = gate:FindFirstChild("Door", true)
		if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
			addBox(door, 6)
		end
	end
	table.sort(signatures)
	return { Boxes = boxes, Circles = circles, Signature = table.concat(signatures, "|") }
end

function CornLayout.IsExcluded(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): boolean
	for _, circle in exclusions.Circles do
		local delta = position - circle.Center
		if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= circle.Radius * circle.Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions.Boxes do
		local localPosition = box.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math.abs(localPosition.X) <= box.HalfSize.X
			and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= box.HalfSize.Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

return CornLayout

				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = 10 })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/spawn/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if gate then
		local door = gate:FindFirstChild("Door", true)
		if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
			addBox(door, 6)
		end
	end
	table.sort(signatures)
	return { Boxes = boxes, Circles = circles, Signature = table.concat(signatures, "|") }
end

function CornLayout.IsExcluded(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): boolean
	for _, circle in exclusions.Circles do
		local delta = position - circle.Center
		if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= circle.Radius * circle.Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions.Boxes do
		local localPosition = box.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math.abs(localPosition.X) <= box.HalfSize.X
			and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= box.HalfSize.Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

return CornLayout

	{ "ClockTime", "Brightness", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "FogColor", "FogStart", "FogEnd" }
local ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES = { "Density", "Haze", "Offset", "Color", "Decay" }

function LightingModes.IsValid(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "string" and (value == "easy" or value == "medium" or value == "hard")
end

function LightingModes.Capture(lighting: Lighting): any
	local state = { lighting = {}, atmospheres = {} }
	for _, property in LIGHTING_PROPERTIES do
		state.lighting[property] = (lighting :: any)[property]
	end
	for _, effect in lighting:GetChildren() do
		if effect:IsA("Atmosphere") then
			local values = {}
			for _, property in ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES do
				values[property] = (effect :: any)[property]
			end
			table.insert(state.atmospheres, { instance = effect, values = values })
		end
	end
	return state
end

function LightingModes.Apply(lighting: Lighting, mode: string)
	assert(LightingModes.IsValid(mode), "Unknown lighting mode")
	local profile = (LightingModes.Profiles :: any)[mode]
	for _, property in LIGHTING_PROPERTIES do
		(lighting :: any)[property] = profile[property]
	end
	for _, effect in lighting:GetChildren() do
		if effect:IsA("Atmosphere") then
			for _, property in ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES do
				(effect :: any)[property] = profile[property]
			end
		end
	end
end

function LightingModes.Restore(lighting: Lighting, state: any)
	for property, value in state.lighting do
		(lighting :: any)[property] = value
	end
	for _, entry in state.atmospheres do
		if entry.instance.Parent == lighting then
			for property, value in entry.values do
				entry.instance[property] = value
			end
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(LightingModes)

--!strict

local MinimapGeometry = {
	CompactSize = 180,
	UpdateHz = 10,
	VisitPadding = 3,
	VisitHeight = 12,
	ClearingRadius = 6,
}

export type Visit = { id: string, kind: string, position: Vector3 }
export type Death = { id: number, kind: string, position: Vector3 }
export type History = { round_id: number, visited: { Visit }, deaths: { Death } }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function position(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z)
end

function MinimapGeometry.IsValid(value: any): boolean
	if
		typeof(value) ~= "table"
		or not finite(value.round_id)
		or value.round_id < 0
		or value.round_id % 1 ~= 0
	then
		return false
	end
	if
		typeof(value.visited) ~= "table"
		or typeof(value.deaths) ~= "table"
		or #value.visited > 18
		or #value.deaths > 3
	then
		return false
	end
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local count = 0
	for index, visit in value.visited do
		count += 1
		if
			typeof(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or index < 1
			or index > #value.visited
			or typeof(visit) ~= "table"
			or typeof(visit.id) ~= "string"
			or visit.id == ""
			or #visit.id > 100
			or seen[visit.id]
			or (visit.kind ~= "clearing" and visit.kind ~= "house")
			or not position(visit.position)
		then
			return false
		end
		seen[visit.id] = true
	end
	if count ~= #value.visited then
		return false
	end
	local deaths: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	count = 0
	for index, death in value.deaths do
		count += 1
		if
			typeof(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or index < 1
			or index > #value.deaths
			or typeof(death) ~= "table"
			or not finite(death.id)
			or death.id < 1
			or death.id % 1 ~= 0
			or deaths[death.id]
			or (death.kind ~= "caught" and death.kind ~= "death")
			or not position(death.position)
		then
			return false
		end
		deaths[death.id] = true
	end
	return count == #value.deaths
end

function MinimapGeometry.Project(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, worldPosition: Vector3): Vector2
	local point = frame:PointToObjectSpace(worldPosition)
	return Vector2.new(
		math.clamp(point.X / size.X + 0.5, 0, 1),
		math.clamp(point.Z / size.Z + 0.5, 0, 1)
	)
end

function MinimapGeometry.Heading(frame: CFrame, direction: Vector3): number
	local localDirection = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
	return math.deg(math.atan2(localDirection.X, -localDirection.Z))
end

return MinimapGeometry

ReplicatedStorage/GameShared/Game/Stamin:
--!strict

-- Pure server-side resource rules. No client supplies stamina or elapsed time.
export type State = {
	value: number,
	intent: boolean,
	exhausted: boolean,
	sprinting: boolean,
	tokens: number,
	requestAt: number,
}

local Stamina = {}

function Stamina.new(capacity: number, now: number): State
	return {
		value = capacity,
		intent = false,
		exhausted = false,
		sprinting = false,
		tokens = 12,
		requestAt = now,
	}
end

function Stamina.Request(state: State, value: any, now: number, active: boolean): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
		return false
	end
	if not value then
		-- Release cannot be lost behind a rate limit or inactive phase.
		state.intent = false
		state.exhausted = false
		state.sprinting = false
		return true
	end
	if not active then
		return false
	end
	if state.intent then
		return true
	end
	state.tokens = math.min(12, state.tokens + math.max(0, now - state.requestAt) * 6)
	state.requestAt = now
	if state.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	state.tokens -= 1
	state.intent = true
	return true
end

function Stamina.Step(state: State, dt: number, moving: boolean, active: boolean, balance: any)
	if not active then
		state.intent = false
		state.sprinting = false
		return
	end
	state.sprinting = state.intent and moving and not state.exhausted and state.value > 0
	if state.sprinting then
		state.value =
			math.max(0, state.value - balance.stamina_capacity / balance.sprint_duration_sec * dt)
		if state.value <= 0.000001 then
			state.value = 0
			state.exhausted = true
			state.sprinting = false
		end
	else
		state.value = math.min(
			balance.stamina_capacity,
			state.value + balance.stamina_capacity / balance.stamina_refill_sec * dt
		)
	end
end

return Stamina
ServerScriptService/GameServer/Bootstrap:
--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Config = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local map = Workspace:WaitForChild("CornMap", 10)
if
	not map
	or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
	or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
then
	warn("[ChildrenOfCorn] Inactive: editable CornMap missing or another game detected")
	return
end
local Logger = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("Logger"))
local log = Logger.new("ServerBootstrap", Config.Debug)

local servicesFolder = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Services")

type RuntimeModule = {
	Name: string?,
	Order: number?,
	Init: ((self: RuntimeModule, context: any) -> ())?,
	Start: ((self: RuntimeModule, context: any) -> ())?,
}

local loaded: { RuntimeModule } = {}
local byName: { [string]: RuntimeModule } = {}

for _, child in servicesFolder:GetChildren() do
	if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, child)
		if not ok then
			error(
				string.format(
					"Failed to require service %s: %s",
					child:GetFullName(),
					tostring(result)
				)
			)
		end
		if type(result) ~= "table" then
			error(string.format("Service %s must return a table", child:GetFullName()))
		end
		local module = result :: RuntimeModule
		local name = module.Name or child.Name
		if byName[name] then
			error(string.format("Duplicate service name: %s", name))
		end
		module.Name = name
		byName[name] = module
		table.insert(loaded, module)
	end
end

table.sort(loaded, function(a, b)
	return (a.Order or 100) < (b.Order or 100)
end)

local context = {
	Config = Config,
	Services = byName,
	Log = Logger.new("Server", Config.Debug),
}

for _, module in loaded do
	if module.Init then
		module:Init(context)
	end
end

for _, module in loaded do
	if module.Start then
		module:Start(context)
	end
end

log:Info(string.format("Started %d services", #loaded))

--!strict
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CornField = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CornField"))
local AuthoredWorld = {}
AuthoredWorld.__index = AuthoredWorld

local function namedPart(parent: Instance, name: string): BasePart
	local item = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	assert(item and item:IsA("BasePart"), "Missing map part: " .. name)
	return item
end

local function hasTag(item: Instance, tag: string): boolean
	return CollectionService:HasTag(item, tag)
end

local function prompt(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	action: string,
	object: string,
	radius: number
): ProximityPrompt
	assert(not parent:FindFirstChild(name), "Duplicate owned prompt: " .. name)
	local item = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	item.Name = name
	item.ActionText = action
	item.ObjectText = object
	item.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	item.MaxActivationDistance = radius
	item.RequiresLineOfSight = true
	item.HoldDuration = 0
	item.Enabled = false
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

local function inBox(part: BasePart, position: Vector3): boolean
	local point = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y
		and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z
end

local function validateSpawn(root: Model, spawn: BasePart, bounds: BasePart)
	assert(spawn:IsDescendantOf(root), "Spawn must belong to CornMap")
	assert(hasTag(spawn, "corn_spawn"), "Missing corn_spawn tag: " .. spawn.Name)
	local id = spawn:GetAttribute("spawn_id")
	assert(type(id) == "string" and id ~= "", "Spawn id must be a nonempty string: " .. spawn.Name)
	assert(spawn.Anchored, "Spawn must be Anchored: " .. spawn.Name)
	assert(
		spawn.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.999,
		"Spawn must remain horizontal: " .. spawn.Name
	)
	if spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		assert(
			spawn.Enabled and spawn.Neutral,
			"Corner spawn must be enabled and neutral: " .. spawn.Name
		)
	end
	local position = (spawn.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, spawn.Size.Y / 2 + 3.5, 0)).Position
	assert(inBox(bounds, position), "Spawn is outside PlayBounds: " .. spawn.Name)
end

function AuthoredWorld.IsSafeSpawn(root: Model, spawn: BasePart): boolean
	local bounds = root:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	return bounds ~= nil and bounds:IsA("BasePart") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, spawn, bounds)
end

function AuthoredWorld.ReadSpawns(root: Model): { BasePart }
	local bounds = namedPart(root, "PlayBounds")
	local corners = root:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	local spawns: { BasePart } = {}
	if corners then
		assert(
			corners:IsA("Folder")
				and corners:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
				and corners:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized CornerSpawns"
		)
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for _, item in corners:GetChildren() do
			assert(item:IsA("SpawnLocation"), "CornerSpawns must contain only SpawnLocations")
			validateSpawn(root, item, bounds)
			local id = item:GetAttribute("spawn_id") :: string
			assert(not seen[id], "Corner spawn ids must be unique")
			seen[id] = true
			table.insert(spawns, item)
		end
		assert(#spawns == 4, "CornMap must have four corner spawns")
		table.sort(spawns, function(a, b)
			return tostring(a:GetAttribute("spawn_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("spawn_id"))
		end)
	else
		local legacy = namedPart(root, "RoundSpawn")
		validateSpawn(root, legacy, bounds)
		table.insert(spawns, legacy)
	end
	return spawns
end

-- A broken gate or slot must not leave the menu character underneath the map.
function AuthoredWorld.FindSafeSpawn(root: Model): BasePart?
	local bounds = root:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	if not bounds or not bounds:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	local corners = root:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	if
		corners
		and corners:IsA("Folder")
		and corners:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
		and corners:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
	then
		for _, item in corners:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("SpawnLocation") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, item, bounds) then
				table.insert(candidates, item)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return tostring(a:GetAttribute("spawn_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("spawn_id"))
	end)
	if candidates[1] then
		return candidates[1]
	end
	local legacy = root:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if legacy and legacy:IsA("BasePart") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, legacy, bounds) then
		return legacy
	end
	return nil
end

function AuthoredWorld.SpawnCFrame(spawn: BasePart): CFrame
	return spawn.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, spawn.Size.Y / 2 + 3.5, 0)
end

function AuthoredWorld.new(radius: number, expectedSlots: number)
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(
		root and root:IsA("Model") and root:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Install the editable CornMap in Children_of_corn before Test"
	)
	local spawns = AuthoredWorld.ReadSpawns(root)
	local field = namedPart(root, "FieldZone")
	local ground = namedPart(root, "Ground")
	local home = root.Props:FindFirstChild("ScarecrowMarker")
	assert(home and home:IsA("Model") and home:HasTag("corn_monster_home"), "Monster home missing")
	local bounds = namedPart(root, "PlayBounds")
	local gateModel = root:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	assert(
		gateModel and gateModel:IsA("Model") and hasTag(gateModel, "corn_gate"),
		"Missing tagged EscapeGate"
	)
	local gate = namedPart(gateModel, "Door")
	local anchor = namedPart(gateModel, "InteractionAnchor")
	local exit = namedPart(gateModel, "ExitZone")
	assert(hasTag(exit, "corn_exit"), "Missing corn_exit tag")
	local gateId = gateModel:GetAttribute("gate_id")
	assert(type(gateId) == "string" and gateId ~= "", "Gate id must be a nonempty string")
	assert(exit:GetAttribute("gate_id") == gateId, "Gate/exit identity mismatch")
	local slots: { BasePart } = {}
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") and hasTag(item, "corn_key_slot") then
			local id = item:GetAttribute("slot_id")
			assert(
				type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" and not seen[id],
				"Key slot ids must be unique strings"
			)
			seen[id] = true
			table.insert(slots, item)
		end
	end
	assert(#slots == expectedSlots, "CornMap must have " .. tostring(expectedSlots) .. " key slots")
	table.sort(slots, function(a, b)
		return tostring(a:GetAttribute("slot_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("slot_id"))
	end)
	assert(not root:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime"), "CornRoundRuntime already exists")
	assert(not anchor:FindFirstChild("CornGatePrompt"), "CornGatePrompt already exists")
	assert(gate.CanCollide, "Closed Door must have CanCollide enabled")
	local artOk, artReady = pcall(CornField.Prepare)
	if not artOk or not artReady then
		warn("[AuthoredWorld] Corn art unavailable:", artReady)
	end
	local runtime = Instance.new("Folder")
	runtime.Name = "CornRoundRuntime"
	runtime:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	runtime.Parent = root
	local gatePrompt = prompt(anchor, "CornGatePrompt", "Открыть", "Ворота", radius)
	local self = setmetatable({
		Root = root,
		Radius = radius,
		Slots = slots,
		Spawns = spawns,
		Spawn = spawns[1],
		Field = field,
		Ground = ground,
		Home = home,
		Bounds = bounds,
		GateModel = gateModel,
		Gate = gate,
		GateAnchor = anchor,
		Exit = exit,
		Runtime = runtime,
		GatePrompt = gatePrompt,
		ClosedTransparency = gate.Transparency,
		ClosedCollision = gate.CanCollide,
		ClosedQuery = gate.CanQuery,
		Key = nil :: Part?,
		KeyPrompt = nil :: ProximityPrompt?,
	}, AuthoredWorld)
	return self
end

function AuthoredWorld:SelectSpawn(index: number): BasePart
	assert(index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= #self.Spawns, "Invalid spawn index")
	local spawn = self.Spawns[index]
	validateSpawn(self.Root, spawn, self.Bounds)
	self.Spawn = spawn
	return spawn
end

function AuthoredWorld:GetSpawnCFrame(): CFrame
	validateSpawn(self.Root, self.Spawn, self.Bounds)
	return AuthoredWorld.SpawnCFrame(self.Spawn)
end

function AuthoredWorld:ClearKey()
	if self.Key then
		self.Key:Destroy()
	end
	self.Key = nil
	self.KeyPrompt = nil
end

function AuthoredWorld:SpawnKeyAt(frame: CFrame): ProximityPrompt
	self:ClearKey()
	local key = Instance.new("Part")
	key.Name = "GateKey"
	key.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 0.4, 3)
	key.CFrame = frame
	key.Anchored = true
	key.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 198, 69)
	key.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	key.CanCollide = false
	key.CanTouch = false
	key.Parent = self.Runtime
	self.Key = key
	self.KeyPrompt =
		prompt(key, "CornKeyPrompt", "Подобрать", "Ключ от ворот", self.Radius)
	return self.KeyPrompt
end

function AuthoredWorld:SpawnKey(slot: BasePart): ProximityPrompt
	assert(slot:IsDescendantOf(self.Root), "Key slot must belong to CornMap")
	return self:SpawnKeyAt(slot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, slot.Size.Y / 2 + 0.3, 0))
end

function AuthoredWorld:DropKey(position: Vector3, radius: number): ProximityPrompt?
	local ray = RaycastParams.new()
	ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = { self.Runtime }
	ray.RespectCanCollide = true
	local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
	overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { self.Root.Props, self.Root.Boundaries, self.Gate }
	overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
	for ring = 0, radius do
		for angle = 0, if ring == 0 then 0 else 7 do
			local offset = Vector3.new(
				math.cos(angle * math.pi / 4),
				0,
				math.sin(angle * math.pi / 4)
			) * ring
			local at = position + offset
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(at + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), ray)
			if
				hit and (hit.Instance == self.Ground or hit.Instance == self.GateModel.ExitGround)
			then
				local place = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
				local obstacles = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
					CFrame.new(place + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)),
					Vector3.new(3, 2, 3),
					overlap
				)
				if #obstacles == 0 and self:IsOnPlayground(place) then
					return self:SpawnKeyAt(CFrame.new(place))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function AuthoredWorld:SetGateOpen(open: boolean)
	self.Gate.CanCollide = if open then false else self.ClosedCollision
	self.Gate.CanQuery = if open then false else self.ClosedQuery
	self.Gate.Transparency = if open then 1 else self.ClosedTransparency
	self.GatePrompt.Enabled = false
	self.Runtime:SetAttribute("GateOpen", open)
end

function AuthoredWorld:SetInteractionEnabled(enabled: boolean, gateOpen: boolean)
	self.GatePrompt.Enabled = enabled and not gateOpen
	if self.KeyPrompt then
		self.KeyPrompt.Enabled = enabled
	end
end

function AuthoredWorld:IsGateFront(position: Vector3): boolean
	local anchor = self.Gate.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(self.GateAnchor.Position)
	local point = self.Gate.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local frontSign = if anchor.Z < 0 then -1 else 1
	return point.Z * frontSign > self.Gate.Size.Z / 2
end

function AuthoredWorld:IsInExit(position: Vector3): boolean
	return inBox(self.Exit, position)
end

function AuthoredWorld:IsOnPlayground(position: Vector3): boolean
	return inBox(self.Bounds, position)
end

function AuthoredWorld:IsValid(): boolean
	if
		self.Root.Parent ~= Workspace
		or not self.Runtime:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.Spawn:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.Field:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.Bounds:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.Gate:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.GateAnchor:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.Exit:IsDescendantOf(self.Root)
		or not self.GatePrompt:IsDescendantOf(self.GateAnchor)
		or #self.Slots ~= 15
	then
		return false
	end
	local spawnIds: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, spawn in self.Spawns do
		if not pcall(validateSpawn, self.Root, spawn, self.Bounds) then
			return false
		end
		local id = spawn:GetAttribute("spawn_id") :: string
		if spawnIds[id] then
			return false
		end
		spawnIds[id] = true
	end
	local gateId = self.GateModel:GetAttribute("gate_id")
	if type(gateId) ~= "string" or gateId == "" or gateId ~= self.Exit:GetAttribute("gate_id") then
		return false
	end
	for _, slot in self.Slots do
		if not slot:IsDescendantOf(self.Root) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

return AuthoredWorld
ServerScriptService/GameServer/Game/Corn:
--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Config = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local CornLayout = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

local CornField = {}
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local OWNER_ATTRIBUTE = "CornRuntimeArtOwned"

function CornField.Prepare(): boolean
	if
		not RunService:IsStudio()
		or Config.Environment ~= "DEV"
		or Config.Game.SessionMode ~= "solo_local"
	then
		return false
	end
	local sources: { Instance } = {}
	for _, item in ServerStorage:GetChildren() do
		if item.Name == "CornPlantTemplate" or item.Name == "SM_Prop_Plant_Corn_01_L" then
			table.insert(sources, item)
		end
	end
	if #sources ~= 1 then
		warn(
			"[CornField] Expected exactly one ServerStorage CornPlantTemplate or SM_Prop_Plant_Corn_01_L art source"
		)
		return false
	end
	local prepared, problem = CornLayout.PrepareTemplate(sources[1])
	if not prepared then
		warn("[CornField] " .. (problem or "Could not prepare corn art"))
		return false
	end
	local folder: Instance? = nil
	for _, item in ReplicatedStorage:GetChildren() do
		if item.Name == "CornRuntimeArt" then
			if folder then
				prepared:Destroy()
				warn(
					"[CornField] Duplicate CornRuntimeArt containers; existing contents were preserved"
				)
				return false
			end
			folder = item
		end
	end
	if
		folder
		and (
			not folder:IsA("Folder")
			or folder:GetAttribute(OWNER_ATTRIBUTE) ~= true
			or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		)
	then
		prepared:Destroy()
		warn("[CornField] Refused to overwrite an unowned CornRuntimeArt container")
		return false
	end
	if folder then
		for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
			if
				item.Name == "CornPlantTemplate"
				and item:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
			then
				prepared:Destroy()
				warn("[CornField] Refused to overwrite unowned CornPlantTemplate art")
				return false
			end
		end
	else
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "CornRuntimeArt"
		folder:SetAttribute(OWNER_ATTRIBUTE, true)
		folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	end
	prepared.Name = "CornPlantTemplate"
	prepared:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", true)
	prepared:SetAttribute("CornPlantHeight", CornLayout.Height)
	for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
		if
			item.Name == "CornPlantTemplate"
			and item:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") == true
		then
			item:Destroy()
		end
	end
	prepared.Parent = folder
	folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	print("[CornField] Prepared a corn art clone; ServerStorage source is unchanged")
	return true
end

return CornField
ServerScriptService/GameServer/Game/MapA:
--!strict
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Layout = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout")
)
local MapAuthoring = {}

local function guard()
	assert(
		RunService:IsStudio() and not RunService:IsRunning(),
		"Use the Command Bar in Studio Edit mode"
	)
	assert(
		not Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base") and not Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models"),
		"Speed Monkey scene detected; Corn installation refused"
	)
	local config = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameShared")
	config = config and config:FindFirstChild("Config")
	local module = config and config:FindFirstChild("GameConfig")
	assert(
		module
			and module:IsA("ModuleScript")
			and string.find(module.Source, 'Id = "children_of_corn"', 1, true),
		"Open the Children_of_corn project"
	)
end

local function artSource(): Instance
	local first = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate")
	local imported = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SM_Prop_Plant_Corn_01_L")
	assert(not (first and imported), "Keep one unambiguous corn source in ServerStorage")
	local source = first or imported
	assert(source, "Imported corn asset missing from ServerStorage")
	return source
end

local function part(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	position: Vector3,
	color: Color3
): Part
	local item = Instance.new("Part")
	item.Name = name
	item.Anchored = true
	item.Size = size
	item.Position = position
	item.Color = color
	item.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	item.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end

local function zone(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3): Part
	local item = part(parent, name, size, position, Color3.fromRGB(123, 175, 113))
	item.Transparency = 1
	item.CanCollide = false
	item.CanTouch = false
	item.CanQuery = false
	return item
end

local function noCorn(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3): Part
	local item = zone(parent, name, size, position)
	CollectionService:AddTag(item, "corn_no_corn_zone")
	return item
end

local function house(parent: Instance, name: string, origin: Vector3)
	local root = Instance.new("Model")
	root.Name = name
	root.Parent = parent
	local walls = part(
		root,
		"Body",
		Vector3.new(20, 12, 24),
		origin + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(95, 84, 62)
	)
	walls.Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
	local door = part(
		root,
		"DecorativeDoor",
		Vector3.new(4, 7, 0.25),
		origin + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, -12.1),
		Color3.fromRGB(58, 45, 33)
	)
	door.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		local roof = part(
			root,
			"Roof",
			Vector3.new(12, 1, 26),
			origin + Vector3.new(side * 5, 14, 0),
			Color3.fromRGB(54, 57, 49)
		)
		roof.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -side * math.pi / 8)
		roof.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
	end
end

function MapAuthoring.EnsureCornerSpawns(map: Model): Folder
	guard()
	assert(
		map.Parent == Workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Corner spawns require the correct editable CornMap"
	)
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	local bounds = map:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	assert(
		field and field:IsA("BasePart") and bounds and bounds:IsA("BasePart"),
		"FieldZone/PlayBounds missing"
	)
	assert(field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.999, "FieldZone must remain horizontal")
	assert(field.Size.X > 100 and field.Size.Z > 100, "FieldZone is too small for corner starts")
	local entries = {
		{ Name = "SW", Id = "solo_corner_sw", X = -1, Z = -1 },
		{ Name = "SE", Id = "solo_corner_se", X = 1, Z = -1 },
		{ Name = "NW", Id = "solo_corner_nw", X = -1, Z = 1 },
		{ Name = "NE", Id = "solo_corner_ne", X = 1, Z = 1 },
	}
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	if old then
		assert(
			old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized CornerSpawns; not replaced"
		)
		assert(#old:GetChildren() == 4, "CornerSpawns must contain exactly four owned starts")
		for _, entry in entries do
			local item = old:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)
			assert(
				item
					and item:IsA("SpawnLocation")
					and item:GetAttribute("spawn_id") == entry.Id
					and item:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnOwned") == true
					and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
					and CollectionService:HasTag(item, "corn_spawn")
					and item.Enabled
					and item.Neutral,
				"Unknown or invalid corner start: " .. entry.Name
			)
			local position = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
				(item.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, item.Size.Y / 2 + 3.5, 0)).Position
			)
			local half = bounds.Size / 2
			assert(
				math.abs(position.X) <= half.X
					and math.abs(position.Y) <= half.Y
					and math.abs(position.Z) <= half.Z
					and item.Anchored
					and item.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.999,
				"Corner start is unsafe: " .. entry.Name
			)
		end
		return old
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornerSpawns"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		for _, entry in entries do
			local localPosition = Vector3.new(
				entry.X * (field.Size.X / 2 - 50),
				-field.Size.Y / 2 + 0.075,
				entry.Z * (field.Size.Z / 2 - 50)
			)
			local position = field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
			local center = Vector3.new(field.Position.X, position.Y, field.Position.Z)
			local item = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
			item.Parent = folder
			item.Name = entry.Name
			item.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.15, 6)
			item.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, center)
			item.Anchored = true
			item.CanCollide = false
			item.CanTouch = false
			item.CanQuery = false
			item.Neutral = true
			item.Enabled = true
			item.AllowTeamChangeOnTouch = false
			item.Duration = 0
			item.Color = Color3.fromRGB(158, 176, 150)
			item:SetAttribute("spawn_id", entry.Id)
			item:SetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
			CollectionService:AddTag(item, "corn_spawn")
			local candidate = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
				(item.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, item.Size.Y / 2 + 3.5, 0)).Position
			)
			local half = bounds.Size / 2
			assert(
				math.abs(candidate.X) <= half.X
					and math.abs(candidate.Y) <= half.Y
					and math.abs(candidate.Z) <= half.Z,
				"Corner start is outside PlayBounds"
			)
			item.Parent = folder
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(problem))
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	return folder
end

function MapAuthoring.Preview(map: Model, center: Vector3, radius: number?): number
	guard()
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(field and field:IsA("BasePart"), "CornMap FieldZone missing")
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	assert(
		not old
			or (
				old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			),
		"Unrecognized EditorPreview; not replaced"
	)
	local prepared, problem = Layout.PrepareTemplate(artSource())
	assert(prepared, problem or "Cannot prepare corn preview")
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "EditorPreview"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorPreview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local distance = math.clamp(radius or 55, 10, 85)
	local localCenter = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(center)
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = Layout.GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn = math.max(minColumn, math.ceil((localCenter.X - distance) / Layout.Spacing))
	maxColumn = math.min(maxColumn, math.floor((localCenter.X + distance) / Layout.Spacing))
	minRow = math.max(minRow, math.ceil((localCenter.Z - distance) / Layout.Spacing))
	maxRow = math.min(maxRow, math.floor((localCenter.Z + distance) / Layout.Spacing))
	local exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local count = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for row = minRow, maxRow do
			for column = minColumn, maxColumn do
				local position = Layout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
				local delta = position - center
				if
					Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude <= distance
					and not Layout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
				then
					local clone = prepared:Clone()
					assert(clone, "Corn clone is not Archivable")
					clone.Name = "Corn"
					Layout.ApplyVariation(clone, column, row)
					clone:PivotTo(
						Layout.PivotForPlant(
							clone,
							position,
							Layout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw
						)
					)
					clone.Parent = folder
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	prepared:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	folder:SetAttribute("PlantCount", count)
	map:SetAttribute("EditorCornCount", count)
	return count
end

-- Whole-map coarse corn for authoring and distant view; fine plants stay local.
function MapAuthoring.RebuildOverview(map: Model): number
	guard()
	assert(
		map.Parent == Workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"CornMap missing"
	)
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(field and field:IsA("BasePart"), "FieldZone missing")
	assert(field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.9999, "FieldZone must stay horizontal")
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if old then
		assert(
			old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized overview; retained"
		)
		for _, item in old:GetChildren() do
			assert(
				item:IsA("BasePart")
					and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
					and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
				"Overview contains manual objects; retained"
			)
		end
	end
	local prepared, problem = Layout.PrepareTemplate(artSource())
	assert(prepared, problem or "Cannot prepare overview art")
	assert(prepared:IsA("MeshPart"), "Whole-field overview requires the imported single-mesh corn")
	local stride = 12
	-- Preserve plant proportions. This sparse layer is an approximate field overview,
	-- while EditorPreview and the client renderer provide dense, life-size plants.
	local _, preparedSize = Layout.Bounds(prepared)
	local half = preparedSize / 2
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "EditorFieldOverview"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewSpacing", stride)
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewApproximation", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewPlantScale", 1)
	local exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local _, yaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local count = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for row = math.ceil(-field.Size.Z / 2 / stride), math.floor(field.Size.Z / 2 / stride) do
			for column = math.ceil(-field.Size.X / 2 / stride), math.floor(field.Size.X / 2 / stride) do
				local ground = field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
					Vector3.new(column * stride, -field.Size.Y / 2, row * stride)
				)
				local excluded = false
				for _, x in { -1, 0, 1 } do
					for _, z in { -1, 0, 1 } do
						local sample = ground
							+ field.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(
								Vector3.new(x * half.X, 0, z * half.Z)
							)
						if Layout.IsExcluded(sample, exclusions) then
							excluded = true
							break
						end
					end
					if excluded then
						break
					end
				end
				if excluded then
					continue
				end
				local clone = prepared:Clone()
				assert(clone, "Overview clone failed")
				clone.Name = "DistantCorn"
				clone:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
				clone:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
				local cellColumn = math.round(column * stride / Layout.Spacing)
				local cellRow = math.round(row * stride / Layout.Spacing)
				Layout.ApplyVariation(clone, cellColumn, cellRow)
				clone:PivotTo(
					Layout.PivotForPlant(clone, ground, yaw + Layout.CellYaw(cellColumn, cellRow))
				)
				clone.Parent = folder
				count += 1
				if count % 128 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	prepared:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("PlantCount", count)
	folder.Parent = map
	print(
		"CornMap whole-field overview:",
		count,
		"upright sparse overview meshes; fine corn uses 3-stud spacing"
	)
	return count
end

function MapAuthoring.PreviewAtSelection(): number
	guard()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(
		map and map:IsA("Model") and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"CornMap missing"
	)
	local spawn: Instance? = map:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if not spawn then
		local corners = map:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
		spawn = corners and corners:FindFirstChild("SW")
	end
	assert(spawn and spawn:IsA("BasePart"), "CornMap has no preview start")
	local center = spawn.Position
	local selected = Selection:Get()[1]
	if selected and (selected:IsA("Model") or selected:IsA("BasePart")) then
		center = selected:GetPivot().Position
	end
	local count = MapAuthoring.Preview(map, center)
	print("CornMap editor preview:", count, "plants near selection")
	return count
end

	end)
	if not ok then
		root:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	print(
		"CornMap installed: 1200 x 1200 studs, 15 key slots, gate, 3 barrels, 3 decorative houses"
	)
	return root
end
return MapAuthoring

--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Authoring = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MapAuthoring"))
local MapTuning = {}

local function torch(parent: Folder, id: string, position: Vector3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = id
	model:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	model:SetAttribute("CornTorchOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("torch_id", id)
	model:AddTag("corn_torch")
	local function part(name: string, size: Vector3, offset: Vector3, color: Color3): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + offset)
		p.Color = color
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end
	local pole = part(
		"Pole",
		Vector3.new(0.45, 13, 0.45),
		Vector3.new(0, 6.5, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(69, 48, 30)
	)
	pole.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	local top = part(
		"Flame",
		Vector3.new(0.65, 0.8, 0.65),
		Vector3.new(0, 13, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 142, 40)
	)
	top.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Name = "TorchFire"
	fire.Size = 3
	fire.Heat = 4
	fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)
	fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 15)
	fire.Parent = top
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "TorchLight"
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 168, 86)
	light.Range = 18
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = top
	model.PrimaryPart = pole
	model.Parent = parent
end

function MapTuning.Apply(map: Model): any
	assert(RunService:IsStudio() and not RunService:IsRunning(), "Stop Play before map tuning")
	assert(
		map.Parent == workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Wrong Corn scene"
	)
	assert(
		not workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base") and not workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models"),
		"Wrong game"
	)
	assert(
		map:GetAttribute("MapTuningVersion") == nil,
		"Map tuning already installed; preserve manual edits"
	)
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") :: BasePart
	local ground = map:FindFirstChild("Ground") :: BasePart
	local bounds = map:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds") :: BasePart
	assert(
		field
			and ground
			and bounds
			and math.abs(field.Size.X - 1200) < 0.1
			and math.abs(field.Size.Z - 1200) < 0.1,
		"Expected 1200 field"
	)
	assert(field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.9999, "Horizontal field required")
	local gateDoor = map.EscapeGate.Door :: BasePart
	local gatePosition = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(gateDoor.Position)
	assert(
		math.abs(gatePosition.X) < 0.1
			and math.abs(gatePosition.Z - 601) < 0.1
			and math.abs(gateDoor.Size.X - 12) < 0.1,
		"Custom gate geometry requires a new resize plan; nothing changed"
	)
	local oldFolders = {}
	for _, name in { "EditorPreview", "EditorFieldOverview" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(name)
		assert(
			folder
				and folder:IsA("Folder")
				and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unknown decoration folder"
		)
		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
			assert(
				child:IsA("BasePart")
					and (
						name == "EditorPreview" and child.Name == "Corn"
						or child:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
					),
				"Manual decoration retained"
			)
		end
		table.insert(oldFolders, folder)
	end
	assert(not map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers"), "TorchMarkers collision")
	local original, pivots = {}, {}
	for _, item in map:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(original, { item = item, frame = item.CFrame, size = item.Size })
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then
			table.insert(pivots, { item = item, pivot = item.WorldPivot })
		end
	end
	local oldAttributes = map:GetAttributes()
	local oldLighting = {
		ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
		Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
		FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
		FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
	}
	local marker = map.Props.ScarecrowMarker
	local hadHome = marker:HasTag("corn_monster_home")
	local oldHome = marker:GetAttribute("monster_home_id")
	local created = {}
	local function rollback()
		for _, item in created do
			item:Destroy()
		end
		for _, name in { "EditorPreview", "EditorFieldOverview" } do
			local item = map:FindFirstChild(name)
			if item then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for _, entry in original do
			entry.item.CFrame = entry.frame
			entry.item.Size = entry.size
		end
		for _, entry in pivots do
			entry.item.WorldPivot = entry.pivot
		end
		for _, item in oldFolders do
			item.Parent = map
		end
		for key in map:GetAttributes() do
			map:SetAttribute(key, nil)
		end
		for key, value in oldAttributes do
			map:SetAttribute(key, value)
		end
		for key, value in oldLighting do
			(Lighting :: any)[key] = value
		end
		if not hadHome then
			marker:RemoveTag("corn_monster_home")
		end
		marker:SetAttribute("monster_home_id", oldHome)
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		for _, item in oldFolders do
			item.Parent = nil
		end
		local function reduced(position: Vector3): Vector3
			local localPoint = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
				Vector3.new(localPoint.X * 0.7, localPoint.Y, localPoint.Z * 0.7)
			)
		end
		for _, folder in { map.Props, map.KeySlots, map.CornerSpawns, map.NoCornZones } do
			for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
				if item:IsA("Model") then
					local pivot = item:GetPivot()
					item:PivotTo(pivot + (reduced(pivot.Position) - pivot.Position))
				elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
					item.CFrame += reduced(item.Position) - item.Position
				end
			end
		end
		local gate = map.EscapeGate
		local delta = field.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, -180))
		gate:PivotTo(gate:GetPivot() + delta)
		ground.Size = Vector3.new(840, ground.Size.Y, 840)
		field.Size = Vector3.new(840, field.Size.Y, 840)
		bounds.Size = Vector3.new(840, bounds.Size.Y, 880)
		local walls = map.Boundaries
		local function wall(name: string, x: number, z: number, sx: number, sz: number)
			local p = walls[name] :: BasePart
			local localPoint = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position)
			p.CFrame = CFrame.new(field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x, localPoint.Y, z)))
				* p.CFrame.Rotation
			p.Size = Vector3.new(sx, p.Size.Y, sz)
		end
		wall("West", -421, 0, 2, 844)
		wall("East", 421, 0, 2, 844)
		wall("South", 0, -421, 840, 2)
		wall("NorthLeft", -213, 421, 414, 2)
		wall("NorthRight", 213, 421, 414, 2)
		local torches = Instance.new("Folder")
		torches.Name = "TorchMarkers"
		torches:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
		torches:SetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned", true)
		torches.Parent = map
		table.insert(created, torches)
		local floorY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
		for _, slot in map.KeySlots:GetChildren() do
			if slot:IsA("BasePart") then
				torch(
					torches,
					"torch_" .. slot.Name,
					Vector3.new(slot.Position.X, floorY, slot.Position.Z + 4)
				)
			end
		end
		local houses = 0
		for _, model in map.Props:GetChildren() do
			if model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChild("DecorativeDoor") then
				houses += 1
				local door = model.DecorativeDoor :: BasePart
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					local position = door.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(side * 6, 0, -3))
					torch(
						torches,
						"torch_" .. model.Name .. tostring(side),
						Vector3.new(position.X, floorY, position.Z)
					)
				end
			end
		end
		assert(houses == 3 and #torches:GetChildren() == 21, "Expected 15 slots / 3 houses")
		marker:AddTag("corn_monster_home")
		marker:SetAttribute("monster_home_id", "solo_home")
		map:SetAttribute("MapTuningVersion", 1)
		map:SetAttribute("TorchClearanceVersion", 1)
		map:SetAttribute("FieldSide", 840)
		map:SetAttribute("map_version", 3)
		Lighting.ClockTime = 20.5
		Lighting.Brightness = 1
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(38, 42, 53)
		Lighting.FogStart = 55
		Lighting.FogEnd = 320
		Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 27, 36)
		Authoring.RebuildOverview(map)
		Authoring.Preview(map, map.CornerSpawns.SW.Position, 75)
	end)
	if not ok then
		rollback()
		error("Map tuning rolled back: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	for _, item in oldFolders do
		item:Destroy()
	end
	return {
		side = 840,
		torches = 21,
		overview = #map.EditorFieldOverview:GetChildren(),
		preview = #map.EditorPreview:GetChildren(),
	}
end

return MapTuning

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

		:WaitForChild("MinimapGeometry")
)

local BOUNDARY_EPSILON = 0.0001
local MAX_VISITS = 18
local MAX_DEATHS = 3
local HOUSE_NAMES = { "HouseWest", "HouseEast", "HouseNorthWest" }

local MinimapState = { PollInterval = 1 / Geometry.UpdateHz }
MinimapState.__index = MinimapState

local function finitePosition(position: Vector3): boolean
	return position.X == position.X
		and position.Y == position.Y
		and position.Z == position.Z
		and math.abs(position.X) < math.huge
		and math.abs(position.Y) < math.huge
		and math.abs(position.Z) < math.huge
end

function MinimapState.new()
	return setmetatable({
		roundId = 0,
		visited = {} :: { any },
		visitedIds = {} :: { [string]: boolean },
		deaths = {} :: { any },
		deadCharacters = {} :: { [Model]: boolean },
	}, MinimapState)
end

function MinimapState:ClearHistory()
	table.clear(self.visited)
	table.clear(self.visitedIds)
	table.clear(self.deaths)
	table.clear(self.deadCharacters)
end

function MinimapState:ResetHistory()
	self.roundId += 1
	self:ClearHistory()
end

function MinimapState:_visit(id: string, kind: string, position: Vector3): boolean
	if self.visitedIds[id] or #self.visited >= MAX_VISITS or not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	self.visitedIds[id] = true
	table.insert(self.visited, { id = id, kind = kind, position = position })
	return true
end

function MinimapState:Poll(world: any, position: Vector3): boolean
	if not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	local field = world.Field
	if math.abs(position.Y - field.Position.Y) <= Geometry.VisitHeight then
		local radius = Geometry.ClearingRadius + Geometry.VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
		for _, slot in world.Slots do
			if slot:IsDescendantOf(world.Root) and slot:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				local slotId = slot:GetAttribute("slot_id")
				local offset = position - slot.Position
				if
					type(slotId) == "string"
					and slotId ~= ""
					and offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z <= radius * radius
				then
					changed = self:_visit("clearing:" .. slotId, "clearing", slot.Position)
						or changed
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local props = world.Root:FindFirstChild("Props")
	if props then
		for _, name in HOUSE_NAMES do
			local house = props:FindFirstChild(name)
			if house and house:IsA("Model") and house:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
				local frame, size = house:GetBoundingBox()
				-- Horizontal bounds follow the authored house yaw; height is a separate tolerance.
				local projected = Vector3.new(position.X, frame.Position.Y, position.Z)
				local localPosition = frame:PointToObjectSpace(projected)
				if
					math.abs(position.Y - frame.Position.Y) <= Geometry.VisitHeight
					and math.abs(localPosition.X) <= size.X / 2 + Geometry.VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
					and math.abs(localPosition.Z)
						<= size.Z / 2 + Geometry.VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
				then
					changed = self:_visit("house:" .. name, "house", frame.Position) or changed
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return changed
end

function MinimapState:RecordCaught(position: Vector3): boolean
	if #self.deaths >= MAX_DEATHS or not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	table.insert(self.deaths, { id = #self.deaths + 1, kind = "caught", position = position })
	return true
end

function MinimapState:RecordDeath(character: Model, position: Vector3): boolean
	if
		self.deadCharacters[character]
		or #self.deaths >= MAX_DEATHS
		or not finitePosition(position)
	then
		return false
	end
	self.deadCharacters[character] = true
	table.insert(self.deaths, { id = #self.deaths + 1, kind = "death", position = position })
	return true
end

function MinimapState:Snapshot(): any
	local visited = {}
	local deaths = {}
	for _, item in self.visited do
		table.insert(visited, { id = item.id, kind = item.kind, position = item.position })
	end
	for _, item in self.deaths do
		table.insert(deaths, { id = item.id, kind = item.kind, position = item.position })
	end
	return { round_id = self.roundId, visited = visited, deaths = deaths }
end

return MinimapState

--!strict
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local MonsterHunt = {}
MonsterHunt.__index = MonsterHunt

function MonsterHunt.new(world: any, balance: any, startedAt: number)
	local home = world.Home:FindFirstChild("Body") :: BasePart
	assert(home and home:IsA("BasePart"), "Scarecrow home body missing")
	local floor = world.Ground.Position.Y + world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Monster"
	model:SetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned", true)
	model:SetAttribute("HuntState", "dormant")
	local origin = Vector3.new(home.Position.X, floor + 3, home.Position.Z)
	local visuals = {}
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		offset: Vector3,
		color: Color3,
		hidden: boolean?
	): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + offset)
		p.Color = color
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Transparency = 1
		p.Parent = model
		if not hidden then
			table.insert(visuals, p)
		end
		return p
	end
	local root = part("Root", Vector3.new(3, 6, 2), Vector3.zero, Color3.new(), true)
	part("Coat", Vector3.new(4, 7, 2), Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(35, 32, 28)).Material =
		Enum.Material.Fabric
	part("Arms", Vector3.new(10, 1.4, 1.4), Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(54, 43, 30))
	part("Head", Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(101, 76, 45))
	part("Hat", Vector3.new(5, 0.6, 4), Vector3.new(0, 7.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(24, 23, 21))
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		part(
			"Leg",
			Vector3.new(1.1, 3, 1.1),
			Vector3.new(side, -1.5, 0),
			Color3.fromRGB(32, 29, 25)
		)
		local eye = part(
			"Eye",
			Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.1),
			Vector3.new(side * 0.55, 6.2, -1.3),
			Color3.fromRGB(235, 138, 49)
		)
		eye.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	model.Parent = world.Runtime
	return setmetatable({
		world = world,
		balance = balance,
		startedAt = startedAt,
		model = model,
		root = root,
		visuals = visuals,
		home = origin,
		state = "dormant",
		lostSince = nil,
		patrolSlot = nil,
		goal = nil,
		route = nil,
		routeIndex = 2,
		pathAt = -math.huge,
		pathBusy = false,
		generation = 0,
		destroyed = false,
		originalMarker = {},
		blockedSince = nil,
	}, MonsterHunt)
end

function MonsterHunt:_state(state: string)
	self.state = state
	self.model:SetAttribute("HuntState", state)
end

function MonsterHunt:_params(character: Model?): RaycastParams
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if character
		then { self.model, self.world.Home, character }
		else { self.model, self.world.Home }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	return params
end

function MonsterHunt:CanCapture(playerRoot: BasePart): boolean
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	if
		Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > self.balance.monster_capture_radius
		or math.abs(delta.Y) > 7
	then
		return false
	end
	local start = self.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	return workspace:Raycast(
		start,
		playerRoot.Position - start,
		self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	) == nil
end

function MonsterHunt:_patrol(playerPosition: Vector3): Vector3
	local nearest, distance = nil, math.huge
	for _, slot in self.world.Slots do
		local d = (slot.Position - playerPosition).Magnitude
		if slot ~= self.patrolSlot and d < distance then
			nearest = slot
			distance = d
		end
	end
	self.patrolSlot = nearest or self.world.Slots[1]
	return self.patrolSlot.Position
end

function MonsterHunt:_path(goal: Vector3, now: number)
	if self.pathBusy or now - self.pathAt < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.pathBusy = true
	self.pathAt = now
	local generation = self.generation
	local began = self.root.Position
	task.spawn(function()
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
			AgentRadius = 2,
			AgentHeight = 9,
			AgentCanJump = false,
			WaypointSpacing = 4,
		})
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(began, goal)
		end)
		if self.destroyed or self.generation ~= generation then
			return
		end
		self.pathBusy = false
		if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
			self.route = path:GetWaypoints()
			self.routeIndex = 2
		else
			self.route = nil
		end
	end)
end

function MonsterHunt:ResetHome()
	self.generation += 1
	self.pathBusy = false
	self.route = nil
	self.goal = nil
	self.lostSince = nil
	self.blockedSince = nil
	self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.home))
	self:_state("patrol")
end

function MonsterHunt:Step(
	dt: number,
	now: number,
	playerRoot: BasePart,
	protected: boolean
): (boolean, boolean)
	if self.destroyed then
		return false, false
	end
	local awakened = false
	if self.state == "dormant" then
		if now - self.startedAt < self.balance.hunt_start_delay_sec then
			return false, false
		end
		for _, p in self.visuals do
			p.Transparency = 0
		end
		for _, item in self.world.Home:GetDescendants() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name ~= "Pole" then
				self.originalMarker[item] = item.Transparency
				item.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		self:_state("patrol")
		awakened = true
	end
	local delta = playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	if not protected and distance <= self.balance.monster_detect_radius then
		self:_state("chase")
		self.lostSince = nil
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		if protected then
			self:_state("patrol")
			self.goal = nil
		elseif distance > self.balance.monster_lose_radius then
			self.lostSince = self.lostSince or now
			if now - self.lostSince >= self.balance.monster_lose_delay_sec then
				self:_state("patrol")
				self.goal = nil
				self.lostSince = nil
			end
		else
			self.lostSince = nil
		end
	end
	if not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot) then
		return true, awakened
	end
	if self.state == "chase" then
		self.goal = playerRoot.Position
	elseif
		not self.goal
		or (Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.root.Position.Y, self.goal.Z) - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			< 3
	then
		self.goal = self:_patrol(playerRoot.Position)
	end
	local goal = Vector3.new(self.goal.X, self.home.Y, self.goal.Z)
	local params = self:_params(playerRoot.Parent :: Model)
	local direct = goal - self.root.Position
	local obstructed = workspace:Blockcast(
		self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
		Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
		direct,
		params
	) ~= nil
	local target = goal
	if obstructed then
		self:_path(goal, now)
		local route = self.route
		if route then
			while self.routeIndex <= #route do
				local waypoint = Vector3.new(
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.X,
					self.home.Y,
					route[self.routeIndex].Position.Z
				)
				if (waypoint - self.root.Position).Magnitude > 1 then
					target = waypoint
					break
				end
				self.routeIndex += 1
			end
		end
	end
	local direction = target - self.root.Position
	local speed = if self.state == "chase"
		then self.balance.monster_chase_speed
		else self.balance.monster_patrol_speed
	if direction.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local step = direction.Unit * math.min(direction.Magnitude, speed * math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.25))
		local hit = workspace:Blockcast(
			self.root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0),
			Vector3.new(3, 5.4, 2),
			step,
			params
		)
		if not hit then
			local position = self.root.Position + step
			self.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction))
			self.blockedSince = nil
		else
			self.blockedSince = self.blockedSince or now
			if self.state == "patrol" and now - self.blockedSince > 2 then
				self.goal = nil
				self.route = nil
				self.blockedSince = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("TargetDistance", distance)
	return not protected and self:CanCapture(playerRoot), awakened
end

function MonsterHunt:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	self.generation += 1
	for p, transparency in self.originalMarker do
		if p.Parent then
			p.Transparency = transparency
		end
	end
	self.model:Destroy()
	self.state = "stopped"
end

return MonsterHunt
