--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local Config = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local map = Workspace:WaitForChild("CornMap", 10)
if
	not map
	or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
	or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
then
	warn("[ChildrenOfCorn] Inactive: editable CornMap missing or another game detected")
	return
end
local Logger = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("Logger"))
local log = Logger.new("ClientBootstrap", Config.Debug)

local controllersFolder = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Controllers")

type RuntimeModule = {
	Name: string?,
	Order: number?,
	Init: ((self: RuntimeModule, context: any) -> ())?,
	Start: ((self: RuntimeModule, context: any) -> ())?,
}

local loaded: { RuntimeModule } = {}
local byName: { [string]: RuntimeModule } = {}

for _, child in controllersFolder:GetChildren() do
	if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, child)
		if not ok then
			error(
				string.format(
					"Failed to require controller %s: %s",
					child:GetFullName(),
					tostring(result)
				)
			)
		end
		if type(result) ~= "table" then
			error(string.format("Controller %s must return a table", child:GetFullName()))
		end
		local module = result :: RuntimeModule
		local name = module.Name or child.Name
		if byName[name] then
			error(string.format("Duplicate controller name: %s", name))
		end
		module.Name = name
		byName[name] = module
		table.insert(loaded, module)
	end
end

table.sort(loaded, function(a, b)
	return (a.Order or 100) < (b.Order or 100)
end)

local context = {
	Config = Config,
	Controllers = byName,
	Log = Logger.new("Client", Config.Debug),
}

for _, module in loaded do
	if module.Init then
		module:Init(context)
	end
end

for _, module in loaded do
	if module.Start then
		module:Start(context)
	end
end

log:Info(string.format("Started %d controllers", #loaded))

--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local CornLayout = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

type Chunk = {
	Key: string,
	Lod: number,
	Folder: Folder,
	MinColumn: number,
	MaxColumn: number,
	MinRow: number,
	MaxRow: number,
	Column: number,
	Row: number,
	Distance: number,
	Count: number,
	Alive: boolean,
	Done: boolean,
}

type OverviewItem = {
	Part: BasePart,
	PreviousModifier: number,
	Frame: CFrame,
	Size: Vector3,
	Keys: { string },
	Hidden: boolean,
}

local CornController = {
	Name = "CornController",
	Order = 50,
	_enabled = false,
	_connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_map = nil :: Model?,
	_field = nil :: BasePart?,
	_template = nil :: CornLayout.Plant?,
	_folder = nil :: Folder?,
	_chunks = {} :: { [string]: Chunk },
	_queue = {} :: { Chunk },
	_exclusions = nil :: CornLayout.Exclusions?,
	_pivotOffset = CFrame.identity,
	_height = CornLayout.Height,
	_pollElapsed = math.huge,
	_plantCount = 0,
	_lastWarning = "",
	_overviewFolder = nil :: Folder?,
	_overviewParts = {} :: { [BasePart]: OverviewItem },
	_overviewByChunk = {} :: { [string]: { OverviewItem } },
	_overviewDirty = {} :: { [OverviewItem]: boolean },
	_overviewFieldFrame = CFrame.identity,
	_overviewFieldSize = Vector3.zero,
}

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local POLL_SEC = 0.3
local CREATE_BUDGET = 18
local CELL_BUDGET = 100
local TIME_BUDGET_SEC = 0.003
local MAX_CHUNKS = 100
local MAX_PLANTS = 4032

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " .. message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint.
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger.
	local padding = CornLayout.Spacing * 0.75
	local halfX = math.abs(relative.RightVector.X) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.X) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.X) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math.abs(relative.RightVector.Z) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field.Size / 2
	local minX = math.max(relative.Position.X - halfX, -fieldHalf.X)
	local maxX = math.min(relative.Position.X + halfX, fieldHalf.X)
	local minZ = math.max(relative.Position.Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf.Z)
	local maxZ = math.min(relative.Position.Z + halfZ, fieldHalf.Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout.Spacing / 2
	for column = math.floor((minX + offset) / width), math.floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math.floor((minZ + offset) / width), math.floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table.insert(keys, column .. ":" .. row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self._overviewParts do
		if entry.Hidden then
			if entry.Part.Parent then
				entry.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.PreviousModifier
			end
			entry.Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	self:_showOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = nil
	self._overviewParts = {}
	self._overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self._overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self._overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self._map
	local field = self._field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	local cachedCount = 0
	for _ in self._overviewParts do
		cachedCount += 1
	end
	local reusable = self._overviewFolder == folder
		and self._overviewFieldFrame == field.CFrame
		and self._overviewFieldSize == field.Size
		and cachedCount == #children
	-- Validate the whole container before any local visibility changes.
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
		local previous = self._overviewParts[item]
		if not previous or previous.Frame ~= item.CFrame or previous.Size ~= item.Size then
			reusable = false
		end
	end
	if reusable then
		return
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = folder
	self._overviewFieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._overviewFieldSize = field.Size
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self._overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local items = self._overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then
				items = {}
				self._overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table.insert(items, entry)
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self._overviewFolder
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self._overviewDirty do
		local part = entry.Part
		if
			part.Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry.Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local chunk = self._chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk.Done then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry.Hidden then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry.PreviousModifier
			entry.Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		chunk.Alive = false
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._chunks = {}
	self._queue = {}
	self._plantCount = 0
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	self._pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self._height = size.Y
	self._map = map
	self._field = field
	self._template = template
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props.
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self._map :: Model
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local folder = self._folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self._exclusions and self._exclusions.Signature ~= exclusions.Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self._exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local groundHeight = localRoot.Y + field.Size.Y / 2
	if groundHeight > 6 then
		self._elevatedUntil = os.clock() + 2
	end
	local radius = if os.clock() < (self._elevatedUntil or 0)
		then CornLayout.ElevatedRadius
		else CornLayout.RenderRadius
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math.floor((localRoot.X - radius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.X + radius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math.floor((localRoot.Z - radius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.Z + radius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math.max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math.min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math.max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math.min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot.X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot.Z) ^ 2
			if distance <= radius * radius then
				table.insert(desired, {
					Key = chunkColumn .. ":" .. chunkRow,
					Lod = if distance <= CornLayout.DenseRadius ^ 2
						then 1
						elseif distance <= CornLayout.MediumRadius ^ 2 then 2
						else 3,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate.Key] = true
		local chunk = self._chunks[candidate.Key]
		if chunk and chunk.Lod ~= candidate.Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			chunkFolder.Name = "Chunk_" .. candidate.Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate.Lod * CornLayout.Spacing)
			chunkFolder.Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate.Key,
				Lod = candidate.Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate.MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate.MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate.MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate.MaxRow,
				Column = candidate.MinColumn,
				Row = candidate.MinRow,
				Distance = candidate.Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not chunk.Done then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self._template
	local field = self._field
	local exclusions = self._exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os.clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self._queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self._plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if not chunk.Alive or chunk.Done then
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk.Column
		local row = chunk.Row
		chunk.Column += 1
		if chunk.Column > chunk.MaxColumn then
			chunk.Column = chunk.MinColumn
			chunk.Row += 1
		end
		if chunk.Row > chunk.MaxRow then
			chunk.Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk.Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk.Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout.Plant
		plant.Name = "Corn"
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = chunk.Folder
		chunk.Count += 1
		self._plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect.Name == "Flame" then
								effect.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math.clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self._torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self._torchesEnabled = enabled
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self._torchesEnabled = true
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local CornLayout = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

type Chunk = {
	Key: string,
	Lod: number,
	Folder: Folder,
	MinColumn: number,
	MaxColumn: number,
	MinRow: number,
	MaxRow: number,
	Column: number,
	Row: number,
	Distance: number,
	Count: number,
	Alive: boolean,
	Done: boolean,
}

type OverviewItem = {
	Part: BasePart,
	PreviousModifier: number,
	Frame: CFrame,
	Size: Vector3,
	Keys: { string },
	Hidden: boolean,
}

local CornController = {
	Name = "CornController",
	Order = 50,
	_enabled = false,
	_connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_map = nil :: Model?,
	_field = nil :: BasePart?,
	_template = nil :: CornLayout.Plant?,
	_folder = nil :: Folder?,
	_chunks = {} :: { [string]: Chunk },
	_queue = {} :: { Chunk },
	_exclusions = nil :: CornLayout.Exclusions?,
	_pivotOffset = CFrame.identity,
	_height = CornLayout.Height,
	_pollElapsed = math.huge,
	_plantCount = 0,
	_lastWarning = "",
	_overviewFolder = nil :: Folder?,
	_overviewParts = {} :: { [BasePart]: OverviewItem },
	_overviewByChunk = {} :: { [string]: { OverviewItem } },
	_overviewDirty = {} :: { [OverviewItem]: boolean },
	_overviewFieldFrame = CFrame.identity,
	_overviewFieldSize = Vector3.zero,
	_overviewInvalid = true,
	_overviewRuntime = false,
	_overviewConnections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
}

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local POLL_SEC = 0.3
local CREATE_BUDGET = 18
local CELL_BUDGET = 100
local TIME_BUDGET_SEC = 0.003
local MAX_CHUNKS = 100
local MAX_PLANTS = 4032
local LOD_HYSTERESIS = 12
local RETAIN_MARGIN = 18
local ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS = 144

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " .. message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint.
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger.
	local padding = CornLayout.Spacing * 0.75
	local halfX = math.abs(relative.RightVector.X) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.X) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.X) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math.abs(relative.RightVector.Z) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field.Size / 2
	local minX = math.max(relative.Position.X - halfX, -fieldHalf.X)
	local maxX = math.min(relative.Position.X + halfX, fieldHalf.X)
	local minZ = math.max(relative.Position.Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf.Z)
	local maxZ = math.min(relative.Position.Z + halfZ, fieldHalf.Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout.Spacing / 2
	for column = math.floor((minX + offset) / width), math.floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math.floor((minZ + offset) / width), math.floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table.insert(keys, column .. ":" .. row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self._overviewParts do
		if entry.Hidden then
			if entry.Part.Parent then
				entry.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.PreviousModifier
			end
			entry.Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()
	if self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	-- A changed footprint or ownership must never keep an old local coverage mask.
	self:_showOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	for _, connection in self._overviewConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._overviewConnections)
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	self:_showOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = nil
	self._overviewRuntime = false
	self._overviewParts = {}
	self._overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self._overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self._overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder.Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end
	-- The backdrop calls this before capturing authored visibility and publishing Ready.
	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact.
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self._map
	local field = self._field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self._overviewInvalid
		and self._overviewFolder == folder
		and self._overviewFieldFrame == field.CFrame
		and self._overviewFieldSize == field.Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll.
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility. The whole container must be owned.
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = folder
	self._overviewRuntime = runtime
	self._overviewFieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._overviewFieldSize = field.Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table.insert(self._overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder.ChildAdded)
	watch(folder.ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder.AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
	if runtime then
		watch(folder.DescendantAdded)
		watch(folder.DescendantRemoving)
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornClientBackdropOwned"))
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ready"))
	end
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self._overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local items = self._overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then
				items = {}
				self._overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table.insert(items, entry)
		end
		-- The backdrop owns immutable client-only copies; authored overview stays editable.
		if not runtime then
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
		end
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = false
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self._overviewFolder
	if not folder or self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self._overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self._map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self._overviewDirty do
		local part = entry.Part
		if
			part.Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry.Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local chunk = self._chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk.Done or (self._overviewRuntime and chunk.Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry.Hidden then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry.PreviousModifier
			entry.Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		chunk.Alive = false
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._chunks = {}
	self._queue = {}
	self._plantCount = 0
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._elevatedUntil = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	self._pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self._height = size.Y
	self._map = map
	self._field = field
	self._template = template
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props.
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout.DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera.CFrame.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
		else 0
	if math.max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self._elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self._elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self._map :: Model
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local folder = self._folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self._exclusions and self._exclusions.Signature ~= exclusions.Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self._exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os.clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout.ElevatedRadius else CornLayout.RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout.MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self._overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self._overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= CornLayout.Spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math.floor((localRoot.X - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math.floor((localRoot.Z - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math.max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math.min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math.max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math.min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot.X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot.Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn .. ":" .. chunkRow
			local previous = self._chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous.Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9.
				end
				table.insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate.Key] = true
		local chunk = self._chunks[candidate.Key]
		if chunk and chunk.Lod ~= candidate.Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			chunkFolder.Name = "Chunk_" .. candidate.Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate.Lod * CornLayout.Spacing)
			chunkFolder.Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate.Key,
				Lod = candidate.Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate.MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate.MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate.MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate.MaxRow,
				Column = candidate.MinColumn,
				Row = candidate.MinRow,
				Distance = candidate.Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not chunk.Done then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self._template
	local field = self._field
	local exclusions = self._exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os.clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self._queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self._plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if not chunk.Alive or chunk.Done then
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk.Column
		local row = chunk.Row
		chunk.Column += 1
		if chunk.Column > chunk.MaxColumn then
			chunk.Column = chunk.MinColumn
			chunk.Row += 1
		end
		if chunk.Row > chunk.MaxRow then
			chunk.Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk.Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk.Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout.Plant
		plant.Name = "Corn"
		if chunk.Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table.insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
					item.CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = chunk.Folder
		chunk.Count += 1
		self._plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect.Name == "Flame" then
								effect.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math.clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self._torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self._torchesEnabled = enabled
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self._torchesEnabled = true
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local CornLayout = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

type Chunk = {
	Key: string,
	Lod: number,
	Folder: Folder,
	MinColumn: number,
	MaxColumn: number,
	MinRow: number,
	MaxRow: number,
	Column: number,
	Row: number,
	Distance: number,
	Count: number,
	Alive: boolean,
	Done: boolean,
}

type OverviewItem = {
	Part: BasePart,
	PreviousModifier: number,
	Frame: CFrame,
	Size: Vector3,
	Keys: { string },
	Hidden: boolean,
}

local CornController = {
	Name = "CornController",
	Order = 50,
	_enabled = false,
	_connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_map = nil :: Model?,
	_field = nil :: BasePart?,
	_template = nil :: CornLayout.Plant?,
	_folder = nil :: Folder?,
	_chunks = {} :: { [string]: Chunk },
	_queue = {} :: { Chunk },
	_exclusions = nil :: CornLayout.Exclusions?,
	_pivotOffset = CFrame.identity,
	_height = CornLayout.Height,
	_pollElapsed = math.huge,
	_plantCount = 0,
	_lastWarning = "",
	_overviewFolder = nil :: Folder?,
	_overviewParts = {} :: { [BasePart]: OverviewItem },
	_overviewByChunk = {} :: { [string]: { OverviewItem } },
	_overviewDirty = {} :: { [OverviewItem]: boolean },
	_overviewFieldFrame = CFrame.identity,
	_overviewFieldSize = Vector3.zero,
	_overviewInvalid = true,
	_overviewRuntime = false,
	_overviewConnections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
}

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local POLL_SEC = 0.3
local CREATE_BUDGET = 18
local CELL_BUDGET = 100
local TIME_BUDGET_SEC = 0.003
local MAX_CHUNKS = 100
local MAX_PLANTS = 4032
local LOD_HYSTERESIS = 12
local RETAIN_MARGIN = 18
local ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS = 144

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " .. message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint.
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger.
	local padding = CornLayout.Spacing * 0.75
	local halfX = math.abs(relative.RightVector.X) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.X) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.X) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math.abs(relative.RightVector.Z) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field.Size / 2
	local minX = math.max(relative.Position.X - halfX, -fieldHalf.X)
	local maxX = math.min(relative.Position.X + halfX, fieldHalf.X)
	local minZ = math.max(relative.Position.Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf.Z)
	local maxZ = math.min(relative.Position.Z + halfZ, fieldHalf.Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout.Spacing / 2
	for column = math.floor((minX + offset) / width), math.floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math.floor((minZ + offset) / width), math.floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table.insert(keys, column .. ":" .. row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self._overviewParts do
		if entry.Hidden then
			if entry.Part.Parent then
				entry.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.PreviousModifier
			end
			entry.Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()
	if self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	-- A changed footprint or ownership must never keep an old local coverage mask.
	self:_showOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	for _, connection in self._overviewConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._overviewConnections)
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	self:_showOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = nil
	self._overviewRuntime = false
	self._overviewParts = {}
	self._overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self._overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self._overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder.Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end
	-- The backdrop calls this before capturing authored visibility and publishing Ready.
	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact.
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self._map
	local field = self._field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self._overviewInvalid
		and self._overviewFolder == folder
		and self._overviewFieldFrame == field.CFrame
		and self._overviewFieldSize == field.Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll.
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility. The whole container must be owned.
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = folder
	self._overviewRuntime = runtime
	self._overviewFieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._overviewFieldSize = field.Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table.insert(self._overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder.ChildAdded)
	watch(folder.ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder.AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
	if runtime then
		watch(folder.DescendantAdded)
		watch(folder.DescendantRemoving)
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornClientBackdropOwned"))
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ready"))
	end
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self._overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local items = self._overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then
				items = {}
				self._overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table.insert(items, entry)
		end
		-- The backdrop owns immutable client-only copies; authored overview stays editable.
		if not runtime then
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
		end
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = false
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self._overviewFolder
	if not folder or self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self._overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self._map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self._overviewDirty do
		local part = entry.Part
		if
			part.Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry.Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local chunk = self._chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk.Done or (self._overviewRuntime and chunk.Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry.Hidden then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry.PreviousModifier
			entry.Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		chunk.Alive = false
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._chunks = {}
	self._queue = {}
	self._plantCount = 0
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._elevatedUntil = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	self._pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self._height = size.Y
	self._map = map
	self._field = field
	self._template = template
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props.
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout.DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera.CFrame.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
		else 0
	if math.max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self._elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self._elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self._map :: Model
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local folder = self._folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self._exclusions and self._exclusions.Signature ~= exclusions.Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self._exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local width = CornLayout.Spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os.clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout.ElevatedRadius else CornLayout.RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout.MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self._overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self._overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= CornLayout.Spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math.floor((localRoot.X - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math.floor((localRoot.Z - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math.max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math.min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math.max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math.min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout.Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot.X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot.Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn .. ":" .. chunkRow
			local previous = self._chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous.Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9.
				end
				table.insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate.Key] = true
		local chunk = self._chunks[candidate.Key]
		if chunk and chunk.Lod ~= candidate.Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			chunkFolder.Name = "Chunk_" .. candidate.Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate.Lod * CornLayout.Spacing)
			chunkFolder.Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate.Key,
				Lod = candidate.Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate.MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate.MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate.MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate.MaxRow,
				Column = candidate.MinColumn,
				Row = candidate.MinRow,
				Distance = candidate.Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not chunk.Done then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self._template
	local field = self._field
	local exclusions = self._exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os.clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self._queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self._plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if not chunk.Alive or chunk.Done then
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk.Column
		local row = chunk.Row
		chunk.Column += 1
		if chunk.Column > chunk.MaxColumn then
			chunk.Column = chunk.MinColumn
			chunk.Row += 1
		end
		if chunk.Row > chunk.MaxRow then
			chunk.Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk.Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk.Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout.Plant
		plant.Name = "Corn"
		if chunk.Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table.insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = chunk.Folder
		chunk.Count += 1
		self._plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect.Name == "Flame" then
								effect.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math.clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self._torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self._torchesEnabled = enabled
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self._torchesEnabled = true
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController

		or previous.phase ~= snapshot.phase
		or previous.minimap.round_id ~= snapshot.minimap.round_id
	then
		self:SetExpanded(false)
		self._elapsed = math.huge
	end
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self._visible = VISIBLE_PHASES[snapshot.phase] == true

function MinimapController:_update()
	if not self._visible then
		return
	end
	local field = self._field
	if not field or not field:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		self._field = nil
		local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
		if map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn" then
			for _, candidate in CollectionService:GetTagged("corn_field_zone") do
				if candidate:IsA("BasePart") and candidate:IsDescendantOf(map) then
					self._field = candidate
					break
				end
			end
		end
		field = self._field
	end
	if not field or field.Size.X <= 0 or field.Size.Z <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local position = nil
	local direction = nil
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	if snapshot and (snapshot.phase == "active" or snapshot.phase == "caught") then
		local character = player.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			position = root.Position
			direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
		end
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local topLeft, bottomRight = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		self._hud:SetViewport(camera.ViewportSize - topLeft - bottomRight)
	end
	self._hud:Update(field.CFrame, field.Size, position, direction)
end

		self._connections,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
			if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then

			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then

					self:SetExpanded(false)
				end
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M and not processed and self._visible then
				self:SetExpanded(not self._expanded)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self._elapsed += dt
			if self._elapsed >= 1 / Geometry.UpdateHz then
				self._elapsed = 0
				self:_update()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function MinimapController:Destroy()
	self:SetExpanded(false)
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._hud:Destroy()
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._movement = nil
end

return MinimapController

function MovementController:_render()
	local cursorFree = self._cursorOpen or self._mapOpen
	self._gui.Enabled = self._active or self._mapOpen
	self._staminaPanel.Visible = self._active
	self._cursorGuard.Visible = self._mapOpen or (self._active and cursorFree)
	if self._roundLeave then
		self._roundLeave.Modal = self._active and cursorFree
	end
	local s = self._snapshot
	if not s then

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local EndpointNames = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))
local MinimapGeometry = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("MinimapGeometry"))
local RoundHud = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RoundHud"))

type Snapshot = RoundHud.Snapshot

local RoundController = {
	Name = "RoundController",
	Order = 100,
	_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
	_requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?,
	_snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_lastRequest = -math.huge,
	_hud = nil :: any,
}

local PHASES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	ready = true,
	preparing = true,
	active = true,
	escaped = true,
	aborted = true,
	caught = true,
	caught_out = true,
}
local ACTIONS: { [string]: boolean } = {
	start = true,
	retry = true,
	abort = true,
	menu = true,
}
local DEBOUNCE_SEC = 0.55
local REMOTE_WAIT_SEC = 10

local function nonnegativeNumber(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
end

local function validSnapshot(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "table"
		and LightingModes.IsValid(value.lighting_mode)
		and MinimapGeometry.IsValid(value.minimap)
		and typeof(value.phase) == "string"
		and PHASES[value.phase] == true
		and typeof(value.has_key) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.gate_open) == "boolean"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.session_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.reward_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.elapsed_sec)
		and typeof(value.notice) == "string"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina_capacity)
		and value.stamina_capacity > 0
		and value.stamina <= value.stamina_capacity
		and typeof(value.is_sprinting) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.sprint_exhausted) == "boolean"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.catches_remaining)
		and value.catches_remaining <= 2
		and value.catches_remaining % 1 == 0
		and typeof(value.monster_state) == "string"
		and ({ dormant = true, patrol = true, chase = true, stopped = true })[value.monster_state] == true
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.protection_sec)
		and typeof(value.start_look) == "Vector3"
		and value.start_look.Magnitude > 0.99
		and value.start_look.Magnitude < 1.01
		and math.abs(value.start_look.Y) < 0.001
end

local function getRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent?
	local instance = folder:WaitForChild(name, REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not instance or not instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		warn(
			string.format(
				"[RoundController] RemoteEvent %s is unavailable after %ds",
				name,
				REMOTE_WAIT_SEC
			)
		)
		return nil
	end
	return instance
end

function RoundController:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?
	self._requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
	self._snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._lastRequest = -math.huge
	self._hud = nil

	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not playerGui or not playerGui:IsA("PlayerGui") then
		warn("[RoundController] PlayerGui is unavailable; the round interface was not created")
		return
	end
	self._hud = RoundHud.new(playerGui)
	self._hud:SetOnAction(function(action: string, mode: string?)
		self:_request(action, mode)
	end)
end

function RoundController:_request(action: string, mode: string?)
	local remote = self._requestRemote
	local hud = self._hud
	if not remote or not hud or not self._snapshot or ACTIONS[action] ~= true then
		return
	end
	if (action == "start" or action == "retry") and not LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastRequest < DEBOUNCE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._lastRequest = now
	hud:SetBusy(true)
	remote:FireServer(action, mode)
	-- Only the server changes the view. A rejected request must not leave buttons stuck.
	task.delay(DEBOUNCE_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud then
			hud:SetBusy(false)
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Start(context: any)
	local hud = self._hud
	if not hud then
		return
	end
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameRemotes", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
		warn("[RoundController] GameRemotes is unavailable; check RoundService startup in Output")
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	local requestRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RequestRoundAction)
	local snapshotRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RoundSnapshot)
	if not requestRemote or not snapshotRemote then
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	self._requestRemote = requestRemote
	self._snapshotConnection = snapshotRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload: any)
		if not validSnapshot(payload) then
			warn("[RoundController] Ignored a malformed round_snapshot")
			return
		end
		self._snapshot = payload :: Snapshot
		hud:Render(payload :: Snapshot)
		context.Controllers.MovementController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.MinimapController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.CornController:SetLightingMode(
			if payload.phase == "ready" then nil else payload.lighting_mode
		)
	end)

	-- Subscribe first: initial server messages may precede the client controller.
	requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
	task.delay(2, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
		end
	end)
	task.delay(REMOTE_WAIT_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			warn("[RoundController] No valid initial round_snapshot; check RoundService Output")
			hud:ShowUnavailable()
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Destroy()
	if self._snapshotConnection then
		self._snapshotConnection:Disconnect()
		self._snapshotConnection = nil
	end
	if self._hud then
		self._hud:Destroy()
		self._hud = nil
	end
	self._requestRemote = nil
end

return RoundController

local function round(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = parent
end

local function frame(
	parent: Instance,

	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local function skull(parent: Instance, name: string, scale: number): Frame
	local marker = frame(
		parent,
		name,
		UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 18 * scale),
		UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		RED
	)
	marker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	marker.ZIndex = 5
	local function part(
		partName: string,
		width: number,
		height: number,
		x: number,
		y: number,
		color: Color3,
		radius: number?
	)
		local item = frame(
			marker,
			partName,
			UDim2.fromOffset(width * scale, height * scale),
			UDim2.fromOffset(x * scale, y * scale),
			color
		)
		item.ZIndex = 6
		if radius then
			round(item, radius * scale)
		end
		return item
	end
	part("Head", 16, 13, 0, 0, RED, 6)
	part("Jaw", 10, 7, 3, 10, RED, 2)
	part("LeftEye", 4, 4, 2, 5, DARK, 1)
	part("RightEye", 4, 4, 10, 5, DARK, 1)
	part("Nose", 2, 3, 7, 8, DARK, 1)
	for x = 5, 11, 3 do
		part("Tooth" .. x, 1, 4, x, 13, DARK)
	end
	return marker
end

local function mapView(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	side: number,
	position: UDim2,
	expanded: boolean
): any
	local box = frame(parent, name, UDim2.fromOffset(side, side), position, PANEL)
	local field = frame(box, "Field", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), FIELD)
	field.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Color = GRID
	border.Thickness = 1
	border.Parent = field

	return { Field = field, Arrow = arrow, Visited = {}, Deaths = {}, Expanded = expanded }
end

local function place(marker: GuiObject, field: Frame, point: Vector2)
	local dimensions = field.AbsoluteSize
	local padX = math.min(0.49, 13 / math.max(1, dimensions.X))
	local padY = math.min(0.49, 13 / math.max(1, dimensions.Y))
	marker.Position =
		UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(point.X, padX, 1 - padX), math.clamp(point.Y, padY, 1 - padY))
end

function MinimapHud:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	self._visited = snapshot.minimap.visited
	self._deaths = snapshot.minimap.deaths
	self._count.Text = string.format("Проверено: %d / 18", #self._visited)
	for _, view in self._views do
		local visitedIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			visitedIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Visited[entry.id] then
				local marker = label(
					view.Field,
					"Visited_" .. entry.id,
					UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
					UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					"×",
					if view.Expanded then 22 else 17
				)
				marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				marker.ZIndex = 4
				view.Visited[entry.id] = marker
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Visited do
			if not visitedIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Visited[id] = nil
			end
		end
		local deathIds = {}
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			deathIds[entry.id] = true
			if not view.Deaths[entry.id] then
				view.Deaths[entry.id] =
					skull(view.Field, "Death_" .. entry.id, if view.Expanded then 1.2 else 1)
			end
		end
		for id, marker in view.Deaths do
			if not deathIds[id] then
				marker:Destroy()
				view.Deaths[id] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Update(
	fieldFrame: CFrame,
	fieldSize: Vector3,
	playerPosition: Vector3?,
	direction: Vector3?
)
	local ratio = fieldSize.X / math.max(0.001, fieldSize.Z)
	for _, view in self._views do
		view.Field.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1, ratio), math.min(1, 1 / ratio))
		for _, entry in self._visited do
			place(
				view.Visited[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		for _, entry in self._deaths do
			place(
				view.Deaths[entry.id],
				view.Field,
				Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, entry.position)
			)
		end
		view.Arrow.Visible = playerPosition ~= nil and direction ~= nil
		if playerPosition and direction then
			place(view.Arrow, view.Field, Geometry.Project(fieldFrame, fieldSize, playerPosition))
			view.Arrow.Rotation = Geometry.Heading(fieldFrame, direction)
		end
	end
end

function MinimapHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._onExpand = nil
	self._onClose = nil
	self._gui:Destroy()
end

return MinimapHud

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

	local sun = Instance.new("Frame")
	sun.Name = if mode == "hard" then "Moon" else "Sun"
	sun.Size =
