	view.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Ambient = profile.Ambient
	view.LightColor = if mode == "easy"
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 204)
		elseif mode == "medium" then Color3.fromRGB(182, 126, 90)
		else Color3.fromRGB(65, 80, 110)
	view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.3)
	view.Parent = sky
	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = view
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		neon: boolean?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		item.Parent = world
		return item
	end
	part("Ground", Vector3.new(28, 0.4, 28), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(74, 70, 39))
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for column = 1, 6 do
			local x, z = (column - 3.5) * 3.4, (row - 2.5) * 3.4
			if math.abs(x) > 2.5 or row > 2 then
				local height = 4.5 + ((row + column) % 3) * 0.35
				part(
					"Stalk",
					Vector3.new(0.15, height, 0.15),
					CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
					Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 53)
				)
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					part(
						"Leaf",
						Vector3.new(2, 0.25, 0.7),
						CFrame.new(x + side * 0.65, height * 0.6, z)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, row * 0.4, side * 0.4),
						Color3.fromRGB(99, 119, 43)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	part("House", Vector3.new(5, 4, 4), CFrame.new(-8, 2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(84, 60, 46))
	part("Roof", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 5), CFrame.new(-8, 4.2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(51, 42, 40))
	part("TorchPole", Vector3.new(0.3, 7, 0.3), CFrame.new(2.4, 3.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(86, 60, 38))
	if profile.Torches then
		part(
			"TorchFlame",
			Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7),
			CFrame.new(2.4, 7.3, 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 51),

	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")

	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
	if mode == "hard" then
		local fog = Instance.new("Frame")

		fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fog.BorderSizePixel = 0

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		fade.Parent = fog
	end
end

		_activeLeave = activeLeave,
		_buttons = { start, retry, menu, preparingLeave, activeLeave },
		_connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
		_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
		_busy = false,
		_unavailable = false,
	}, RoundHud)
	for mode, select in modeButtons do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			select.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot then
					self._selectedMode = mode
					self:_render()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()
		end)
	)
	self:_render()
	return self
end

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 510) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 420 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 456 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud
--!strict

	minimap: MinimapGeometry.History,
	lighting_mode: string,
	phase: string,
	has_key: boolean,
	gate_open: boolean,
	session_diamonds: number,
	reward_diamonds: number,
	elapsed_sec: number,
	notice: string,
	stamina: number,

}

local RoundHud = {}
RoundHud.__index = RoundHud

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(27, 32, 28)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(239, 242, 233)
local MUTED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(190, 199, 186)
local BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(84, 109, 67)
local DISABLED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(63, 69, 61)
local NOTICE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 209, 142)
local CHASE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(233, 94, 83)

local function text(key: string, values: { [string]: string | number }?): string
	local template = RoundText[key] or ""
	return (
		string.gsub(template, "{([%w_]+)}", function(name)
			local value = if values then values[name] else nil
			return if value ~= nil then tostring(value) else "{" .. name .. "}"
		end)
	)
end

local function elapsedText(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(whole / 60), whole % 60)
end

local function label(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	fontSize: number
): TextLabel
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Name = name
	result.Size = size
	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	result.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	result.TextSize = fontSize
	result.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
	result.TextWrapped = true
	result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	result.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	result.Text = ""
	result.Parent = parent
	return result
end

local function button(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	key: string,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2
): TextButton
	local result = Instance.new("TextButton")

	result.Position = position
	result.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
	result.BorderSizePixel = 0
	result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium

	result.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(profile.SkyTop, profile.SkyBottom)

	gradient.Parent = sky
	local sun = Instance.new("Frame")
	sun.Name = if mode == "hard" then "Moon" else "Sun"
	sun.Size =
		UDim2.fromOffset(if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22, if mode == "hard" then 12 else 22)

	view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	view.Ambient = profile.Ambient
	view.LightColor = if mode == "easy"
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 204)
		elseif mode == "medium" then Color3.fromRGB(182, 126, 90)
		else Color3.fromRGB(65, 80, 110)
	view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.3)
	view.Parent = sky
	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = view
	local function part(
		name: string,
		size: Vector3,
		frame: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		neon: boolean?
	): Part
		local item = Instance.new("Part")
		item.Name = name
		item.Size = size
		item.CFrame = frame
		item.Color = color
		item.Anchored = true
		item.CanCollide = false
		item.CastShadow = false
		item.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		item.Parent = world
		return item
	end
	part("Ground", Vector3.new(28, 0.4, 28), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(74, 70, 39))
	for row = 1, 4 do
		for column = 1, 6 do
			local x, z = (column - 3.5) * 3.4, (row - 2.5) * 3.4
			if math.abs(x) > 2.5 or row > 2 then
				local height = 4.5 + ((row + column) % 3) * 0.35
				part(
					"Stalk",
					Vector3.new(0.15, height, 0.15),
					CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
					Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 53)
				)
				for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
					part(
						"Leaf",
						Vector3.new(2, 0.25, 0.7),
						CFrame.new(x + side * 0.65, height * 0.6, z)
							* CFrame.Angles(0, row * 0.4, side * 0.4),
						Color3.fromRGB(99, 119, 43)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	part("House", Vector3.new(5, 4, 4), CFrame.new(-8, 2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(84, 60, 46))
	part("Roof", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 5), CFrame.new(-8, 4.2, -9), Color3.fromRGB(51, 42, 40))
	part("TorchPole", Vector3.new(0.3, 7, 0.3), CFrame.new(2.4, 3.5, 1), Color3.fromRGB(86, 60, 38))
	if profile.Torches then
		part(
			"TorchFlame",
			Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7),
			CFrame.new(2.4, 7.3, 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 51),
			true
		)
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 48
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(16, 12, 23), Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0))
	camera.Parent = view
	view.CurrentCamera = camera
	if mode == "hard" then
		local fog = Instance.new("Frame")
		fog.Name = "Mist"
		fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fog.BackgroundColor3 = profile.FogColor
		fog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
		fog.Parent = sky
		local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.7),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		fade.Parent = fog
	end
end

		root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			self:_fitCard()

	return self

function RoundHud:_fitCard()
	local viewport = self._root.AbsoluteSize
	if viewport.X > 0 and viewport.Y > 0 then
		self._cardScale.Scale = math.min(
			1,
			(viewport.X - 36) / self._card.Size.X.Offset,
			(viewport.Y - 36) / self._card.Size.Y.Offset
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:SetOnAction(callback: (string, string?) -> ())
	local bindings = {
		{ button = self._start, action = "start" },
		{ button = self._retry, action = "retry" },
		{ button = self._menu, action = "menu" },
		{ button = self._preparingLeave, action = "abort" },
		{ button = self._activeLeave, action = "abort" },
	}
	for _, binding in bindings do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			binding.button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not self._busy and not self._unavailable and self._snapshot ~= nil then
					callback(
						binding.action,
						if binding.action == "start" or binding.action == "retry"
							then self._selectedMode
							else nil
					)
				end
			end)
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:_render()
	local snapshot = self._snapshot
	local phase = if snapshot then snapshot.phase else "loading"
	local isActive = phase == "active"
	local isResult = phase == "escaped" or phase == "aborted" or phase == "caught_out"
	local expanded = phase == "ready" or isResult
	self._card.Size = if expanded then UDim2.fromOffset(780, 510) else UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	self._modeCards.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Visible = expanded
	self._modeHint.Visible = expanded
	self._chooseMode.Text =
		text("corn_modes_selected", { mode = text("corn_modes_" .. self._selectedMode) })
	self._modeHint.Text = text("corn_modes_hint")
	self._message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 62 else 68)
	self._message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 32 else 52)
	self._time.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 96 else 124)
	self._time.Visible = not expanded or isResult
	self._time.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, if expanded then 22 else 26)
	self._chooseMode.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if isResult then 118 else 110)
	self._balance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 420 else 154)
	self._notice.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, if expanded then 392 else 186)
	self._notice.Visible = not expanded
	for _, control in { self._start, self._retry, self._menu, self._preparingLeave } do
		control.Position = UDim2.new(
			control.Position.X.Scale,
			control.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			if expanded then 456 else 250
		)
	end
	for mode, control in self._modeButtons do
		local enabled = expanded and snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		local selected = mode == self._selectedMode
		control.Text = text(if selected then "corn_modes_selected_button" else "corn_modes_select")
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled
			then (if selected then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR)
			else DISABLED_COLOR
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Color = if selected
			then Color3.fromRGB(204, 190, 114)
			else Color3.fromRGB(61, 71, 60)
		self._modeStrokes[mode].Transparency = if selected then 0 else 0.6
	end
	self:_fitCard()
	self._card.Visible = not isActive
	self._active.Visible = isActive
	self._activeLeave.Visible = isActive
	self._start.Visible = phase == "ready" or phase == "loading"
	self._retry.Visible = isResult
	self._menu.Visible = isResult
	self._preparingLeave.Visible = phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught"
	for _, control in self._buttons do
		local enabled = snapshot ~= nil and not self._busy and not self._unavailable
		control.Active = enabled
		control.AutoButtonColor = enabled
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if enabled then BUTTON_COLOR else DISABLED_COLOR
		control.TextTransparency = if enabled then 0 else 0.35
	end

	self._title.Text = text("corn_loop_title")
	self._time.Text = ""
	self._notice.Text = if snapshot then text(snapshot.notice) else ""
	self._balance.Visible = snapshot ~= nil
	self._balance.Text = text(
		"corn_loop_test_balance",
		{ count = if snapshot then snapshot.session_diamonds else 0 }
	)
	if self._unavailable then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_loop_connection_error")
	elseif phase == "loading" or phase == "preparing" or phase == "caught" then
		self._message.Text = if phase == "caught"
			then text(snapshot and snapshot.notice or "corn_hunt_first_catch")
			else text("corn_loop_loading")
	elseif phase == "ready" then
		self._message.Text = text("corn_modes_choose")
	elseif snapshot and isResult then
		self._title.Text = text(
			if phase == "escaped"
				then "corn_loop_result_escape"
				elseif phase == "caught_out" then "corn_hunt_defeat"
				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self._message.Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot.reward_diamonds })
			else ""
		self._time.Text = text("corn_loop_round_time", { time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) })
	end

	-- Clear inactive/stale warning styling before rendering this confirmed state.
	self._activeNotice.Text = ""
	self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = NOTICE_COLOR
	self._activeNotice.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot.gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot.has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self._objective.Text = text(objectiveKey)
		self._activeTime.Text = text(
			"corn_loop_round_time",
			{ time = elapsedText(snapshot.elapsed_sec) }
		) .. " · " .. text(
			"corn_modes_active",
			{ mode = text("corn_modes_" .. snapshot.lighting_mode) }
		)
		self._activeBalance.Text = self._balance.Text
		local chasing = snapshot.protection_sec <= 0 and snapshot.monster_state == "chase"
		self._activeNotice.Text = if snapshot.protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math.ceil(snapshot.protection_sec) })
			elseif chasing then text("corn_hunt_chase")
			else text(snapshot.notice)
		self._activeNotice.TextColor3 = if chasing then CHASE_COLOR else NOTICE_COLOR
		self._activeNotice.Font = if chasing then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham
		self._activeBalance.Text ..= " · " .. text(
			"corn_hunt_attempts",
			{ count = snapshot.catches_remaining }
		)
	end
end

function RoundHud:Render(snapshot: Snapshot)
	self._unavailable = false
	if snapshot.phase ~= self._lastPhase and snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		self._selectedMode = snapshot.lighting_mode
	end
	self._lastPhase = snapshot.phase
	self._snapshot = snapshot
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:SetBusy(busy: boolean)
	self._busy = busy
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:ShowUnavailable()
	self._unavailable = true
	self:_render()
end

function RoundHud:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._root:Destroy()
end

return RoundHud

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CornLayout = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout")
)

local CornBackdropController = { Name = "CornBackdropController", Order = 45 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local FOLDER_NAME = "CornClientBackdrop"
local STRIDE = 2 -- CornLayout.Spacing * 2 = 6 studs; tune only after foreground engine QA.
local MAX_PLANTS = 20000
local CLONE_BUDGET = 18
local TIME_BUDGET = 0.002
local POLL_SEC = 1

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

local function ownedTree(folder: Instance): boolean
	if not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not owned(item) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function staticArt(template: Instance): boolean
	for _, item in template:GetDescendants() do
		if
			item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
			or item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return template.Archivable
end

function CornBackdropController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornBackdropController] " .. message)
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_bridge(folder: Folder): boolean
	local renderer = self._renderer
	return renderer ~= nil
		and typeof(renderer.UseBackdropReady) == "function"
		and renderer:UseBackdropReady(folder) == true
end

function CornBackdropController:_restoreOriginals()
	for part, previous in self._originals do
		if part.Parent then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._originals)
end

function CornBackdropController:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	local folder = self._folder
	if folder and owned(folder) then
		self:_bridge(folder)
		folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	end
	self:_restoreOriginals()
	if folder then
		if ownedTree(folder) then
			folder:Destroy()
		else
			self:_warn(
				"Changed ownership or foreign backdrop content was preserved; saved overview restored"
			)
		end
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._signature = nil
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
end

function CornBackdropController:_publish(): boolean
	local folder, map = self._folder, self._map
	if not folder or not map or folder.Parent ~= map or not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	local overview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if
		not overview
		or not overview:IsA("Folder")
		or overview:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or overview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_warn("Unrecognized saved overview was preserved; backdrop not published")
		return false
	end
	local originals = overview:GetChildren()
	for _, part in originals do
		if
			not part:IsA("BasePart")
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Foreign saved overview content was preserved; backdrop not published")
			return false
		end
	end
	-- Bridge clears the old near-field mask before we capture its exact original LTM.
	-- No yield between bridge, capture/hide and publication.
	if not self:_bridge(folder) then
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	for _, item in originals do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		self._originals[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
	self._ready = true
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	if not self._renderer or typeof(self._renderer.UseBackdropReady) ~= "function" then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Backdrop needs a prepared BasePart template compatible with near-field coverage; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
		or not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
		or field.Size.X <= 0
		or field.Size.Z <= 0
		or not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or not template:IsA("BasePart")
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		or not staticArt(template)
	then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Owned horizontal field and prepared static art unavailable; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	local signature = exclusions.Signature
		.. "/template/"
		.. tostring(bounds)
		.. "/"
		.. tostring(size)
	local folder = self._folder
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._signature == signature
		and folder
		and folder.Parent == map
		and owned(folder)
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == self._ready
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clear()
	if map:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME) then
		self:_warn("Existing CornMap/CornClientBackdrop was preserved; no replacement attempted")
		return false
	end
	if self._failedSignature == signature then
		return false
	end
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn, minRow = math.ceil(minColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.ceil(minRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	maxColumn, maxRow =
		math.floor(maxColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.floor(maxRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	local candidateCount = (math.floor((maxColumn - minColumn) / STRIDE) + 1)
		* (math.floor((maxRow - minRow) / STRIDE) + 1)
	if candidateCount > MAX_PLANTS or candidateCount <= 0 then
		self:_warn("Full-field grid exceeds the 20000 plant cap; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	self._map, self._field, self._template = map, field, template
	self._exclusions, self._signature = exclusions, signature
	self._minColumn, self._maxColumn = minColumn, maxColumn
	self._minRow, self._maxRow = minRow, maxRow
	self._column, self._row = minColumn, minRow
	self._fieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._fieldSize = field.Size
	self._fieldYaw = math.atan2(-field.CFrame.LookVector.X, -field.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("Stride", STRIDE)
	folder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", STRIDE * CornLayout.Spacing)
	folder:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", MAX_PLANTS)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_advance()
	self._column += STRIDE
	if self._column > self._maxColumn then
		self._column = self._minColumn
		self._row += STRIDE
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_buildStep()
	local folder, field, template, exclusions =
		self._folder, self._field, self._template, self._exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self._ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder.Parent ~= self._map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field.CFrame ~= self._fieldFrame
		or field.Size ~= self._fieldSize
	then
		self:_clear()
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
		return
	end
	local epoch, start = self._epoch, self._clock()
	local created = 0
	while
		self._epoch == epoch
		and self._row <= self._maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self._count < MAX_PLANTS
		and self._clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET
	do
		local column, row = self._column, self._row
		self:_advance()
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local plant = template:Clone()
		if not plant then
			error("Prepared backdrop plant could not be cloned")
		end
		plant.Name = string.format("Far_%d_%d", column, row)
		local parts = plant:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(parts, plant)
		for _, item in parts do
			item:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout.PivotForPlant(
				plant,
				position,
				CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + self._fieldYaw
			)
		)
		plant.Parent = folder
		created += 1
		self._count += 1
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self._clock() - start)
	if self._row > self._maxRow then
		if not self:_publish() then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
		end
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveInputs()
	end
	self:_buildStep()
end

function CornBackdropController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._renderer = context.Controllers.CornController
	self._connection = nil
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._epoch = 0
	self._originals = {}
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._lastWarning = ""
	self._pollElapsed = math.huge
	self._failedSignature = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
			self:_warn("Backdrop build failed; saved overview restored: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function CornBackdropController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
	self._renderer = nil
end

return CornBackdropController

	end
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	local signature = exclusions.Signature
		.. "/template/"
		.. tostring(bounds)
		.. "/"
		.. tostring(size)
	local folder = self._folder
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._signature == signature
		and folder
		and folder.Parent == map
		and owned(folder)
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == self._ready
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clear()
	if map:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME) then
		self:_warn("Existing CornMap/CornClientBackdrop was preserved; no replacement attempted")
		return false
	end
	if self._failedSignature == signature then
		return false
	end
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn, minRow = math.ceil(minColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.ceil(minRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	maxColumn, maxRow =
		math.floor(maxColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.floor(maxRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	local candidateCount = (math.floor((maxColumn - minColumn) / STRIDE) + 1)
		* (math.floor((maxRow - minRow) / STRIDE) + 1)
	if candidateCount > MAX_PLANTS or candidateCount <= 0 then
		self:_warn("Full-field grid exceeds the 20000 plant cap; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	self._map, self._field, self._template = map, field, template
	self._exclusions, self._signature = exclusions, signature
	self._minColumn, self._maxColumn = minColumn, maxColumn
	self._minRow, self._maxRow = minRow, maxRow
	self._column, self._row = minColumn, minRow
	self._fieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._fieldSize = field.Size
	self._fieldYaw = math.atan2(-field.CFrame.LookVector.X, -field.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("Stride", STRIDE)
	folder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", STRIDE * CornLayout.Spacing)
	folder:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", MAX_PLANTS)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_advance()
	self._column += STRIDE
	if self._column > self._maxColumn then
		self._column = self._minColumn
		self._row += STRIDE
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_buildStep()
	local folder, field, template, exclusions =
		self._folder, self._field, self._template, self._exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self._ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder.Parent ~= self._map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field.CFrame ~= self._fieldFrame
		or field.Size ~= self._fieldSize
	then
		self:_clear()
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
		return
	end
	local epoch, start = self._epoch, self._clock()
	local created = 0
	while
		self._epoch == epoch
		and self._row <= self._maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self._count < MAX_PLANTS
		and self._clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET
	do
		local column, row = self._column, self._row
		self:_advance()
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local plant = template:Clone()
		if not plant then
			error("Prepared backdrop plant could not be cloned")
		end
		plant.Name = string.format("Far_%d_%d", column, row)
		local parts = plant:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(parts, plant)
		for _, item in parts do
			item:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout.PivotForPlant(
				plant,
				position,
				CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + self._fieldYaw
			)
		)
		plant.Parent = folder
		created += 1
		self._count += 1
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self._clock() - start)
	if self._row > self._maxRow then
		if not self:_publish() then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
		end
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveInputs()
	end
	self:_buildStep()
end

function CornBackdropController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self._renderer = context.Controllers.CornController
	self._connection = nil
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._epoch = 0
	self._originals = {}
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._lastWarning = ""
	self._pollElapsed = math.huge
	self._failedSignature = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
			self:_warn("Backdrop build failed; saved overview restored: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function CornBackdropController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
	self._renderer = nil
end

return CornBackdropController
